( 2024 ) calibration. \(\#\) : the continuum below the Ly \(\alpha\) was estimated extrapolating \(M_{UV}\) at the relative wavelength according to the \(\beta\) slope and correcting for the extinction (all quantities are reported in Tab. 1 ). \(\star\) : the FWHM was corrected for instrumental broadening. \({\ddagger}\) : the red-blue asymmetry is reported here, with \(A_{{RB}}=(F_{{red}}-F_{{blue}})/F_{{Ly\alpha}}\) , where \(F_{{red}}\) and \(F_{{blue}}\) are the Ly \(\alpha\) fluxes measured red-ward and blue-ward from the line peak, respectively.
figures.caption_zh: 表2：从NIRSpec检测到的\(H\alpha\)、\(H\beta\)和[O III ] \(\lambda\lambda 4959,5007\)谱线推导出的CA4光谱性质。4 4 4 底部行报告了来自X-Shooter的Ly \(\alpha\) 性质，但\(F_{{Ly\alpha}}\)和\({EW_{0}}\)来自MUSE。\({\dagger}\)：假设采用Sanders等人（2024）的校准。\(\#\)：Ly \(\alpha\) 下方的连续谱是通过根据\(\beta\)斜率外推\(M_{UV}\)至相应波长并校正消光来估计的（所有量均报告于表1中）。\(\star\)：FWHM已针对仪器展宽进行了校正。\({\ddagger}\)：此处报告了红蓝不对称性，其中\(A_{{RB}}=(F_{{red}}-F_{{blue}})/F_{{Ly\alpha}}\)，\(F_{{red}}\)和\(F_{{blue}}\)分别是谱线峰值红侧和蓝侧测得的Ly \(\alpha\) 流量。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: 1D (top) and 2D (bottom) X-Shooter spectra centered on the Ly \(\alpha\) , N V \(\lambda 1240\) , C IV \(\lambda\lambda 1548,1550\) , He II \(\lambda 1640\) , O III ] \(\lambda 1666\) , and C III ] \(\lambda 1908\) lines (from left to right). The green colors denote spectra lying in the VIS arm, while red colors in the NIR arm. Only the Ly \(\alpha\) is detected, for the other lines we are able to put stringent upper limits on their EW 0 . The aperture adopted to extract the 1D spectrum, of 1.4″, is showed with white dashed lines in the left panel. The Ly \(\alpha\) emission, at approximately the same redshift of CA4, visible in the top edge of the X-Shooter slit is due to the inclusion in the slit of a counter-image of the main Ly \(\alpha\) halo including CA1, CA2, and CA3, visible in Fig. 1 .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：以Ly \(\alpha\)、N V \(\lambda 1240\)、C IV \(\lambda\lambda 1548,1550\)、He II \(\lambda 1640\)、O III ] \(\lambda 1666\)和C III ] \(\lambda 1908\)谱线（从左到右）为中心的一维（上）和二维（下）X-Shooter光谱。绿色表示位于VIS臂的光谱，红色表示位于NIR臂的光谱。仅检测到Ly \(\alpha\)，对于其他谱线，我们能够对其EW 0 设置严格的上限。用于提取一维光谱的孔径为1.4″，在左面板中以白色虚线显示。在X-Shooter狭缝上边缘可见的、大致与CA4红移相同的Ly \(\alpha\) 发射，是由于狭缝中包含了一个主Ly \(\alpha\) 晕（包括CA1、CA2和CA3，见图1）的对应像。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Ly \(\alpha\) spectrum (green line) of CA4 and best-fit model (red line), obtained with \(z\) ELDA . The values of the best-fit parameters are \(v_{exp}=50\) km s -1 , \(N_{HI}=10^{18.7}\) cm -2 , \(\tau=0.003\) , and EW \({}_{i}^{Ly\alpha}=21.1\,${\text{Å}}$\) . Orange lines show 10 5 realizations of the best-fit model, obtained by randomly extracting the values of each parameter from a normal distribution parametrized by the best-fit value and its uncertainty. The \(x\) -axis is computed with respect to the systemic redshift value of 6.1446.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：CA4的Ly \(\alpha\) 光谱（绿线）和最佳拟合模型（红线），使用\(z\) ELDA获得。最佳拟合参数值为\(v_{exp}=50\) km s -1 、\(N_{HI}=10^{18.7}\) cm -2 、\(\tau=0.003\)和EW \({}_{i}^{Ly\alpha}=21.1\,${\text{Å}}$\) 。橙色线显示了最佳拟合模型的10 5 次实现，通过从由最佳拟合值及其不确定度参数化的正态分布中随机抽取每个参数的值获得。\(x\)轴是相对于系统红移值6.1446计算的。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Summary of the JWST photometric and spectroscopic data and analysis of the additional systems at \(z\sim 6.14\) , namely CA5, CA6, CA7, CA8, CA9, shown in the different rows. Left panels : cutouts from the stacked SW filters (0.02″/pix reduction). The blue regions highlight the apertures adopted for measuring the photometry, while the rectangles highlight the NIRSpec MSA positions (from the DJA archive). Center panels : 2D (top) and 1D (bottom) spectra, zoomed-in around the wavelengths where \(H\gamma\) , \(H\beta\) , [O III ] \(\lambda\lambda 4959,5007\) , and \(H\alpha\) are visible. Right panels : observed photometry (black points) and results from SED fitting (best-fit spectra in blue, and expected photometry as black empty squares). We report the results relative to each subregion of CA5, CA6, and CA7 in Appendix B .
figures.caption_zh: 图6：在\(z\sim 6.14\)处的额外系统（即CA5、CA6、CA7、CA8、CA9，显示在不同行中）的JWST测光和光谱数据及分析总结。左面板：来自叠加SW滤光片（0.02″/像素分辨率）的切图。蓝色区域突出显示了用于测量测光的孔径，而矩形突出显示了NIRSpec MSA位置（来自DJA档案）。中面板：二维（上）和一维（下）光谱，放大到\(H\gamma\)、\(H\beta\)、[O III ] \(\lambda\lambda 4959,5007\)和\(H\alpha\)可见的波长附近。CA5没有呈现发射线，而CA7呈现弱发射线，其预期位置用垂直虚线标记以引导视线。右面板：观测到的测光（黑点）和SED拟合结果（最佳拟合光谱为蓝色，预期测光为黑色空心方块）。我们在附录B中报告了与CA5、CA6和CA7每个子区域相关的结果。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 早期宇宙中大量尘埃储库的快速积累仍然是天体物理学中的一个重大挑战。虽然核心坍缩超新星可以在短时间内注入大尘埃颗粒（$a \gtrsim 0.1\,μ{\rm m}$），但要解释早期宇宙中的总尘埃预算，很可能需要星际介质（ISM）中高效的颗粒生长。这种生长关键依赖于丰富的小颗粒群，它们能最大化可用于吸积的表面积，并可能通过快速的尘埃处理或尘埃形成通道产生。在此，我们报告发现了一个红移为$z=4.556\pm0.003$的类星体UDS-27023，该发现基于JWST/NIRSpec光谱。通过将光谱与类星体复合模板进行定量比较，我们发现UDS-27023显示出异常陡峭的远紫外消光曲线（$A_{1500}/A_V \approx 8$），但明显缺乏2175埃的隆起，这表明其尘埃以硅酸盐小颗粒为主。我们将这一现象解释为类星体环境中活跃的小颗粒产生和加工过程的证据。类星体驱动的激波和外流对预先存在的大颗粒进行机械破碎是一种自然途径，而在类星体驱动的致密风中原位凝结硅酸盐颗粒则提供了额外可能。这类陡消光类星体（SEQs）可能揭示了活跃星系核生成、加工和再分布小颗粒的一个短寿命阶段，从而可能促进星际介质中快速的颗粒生长并丰富星系周介质。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，结论如下：这一现象表明类星体环境中存在活跃的小颗粒产生和加工过程。类星体驱动的激波和外流对预先存在的大颗粒进行机械破碎是一种自然途径，而类星体驱动的致密风中原位凝结硅酸盐颗粒则提供了额外可能。这类陡消光类星体可能揭示了活跃星系核生成、加工和再分布小颗粒的短寿命阶段，有助于促进星际介质中快速的晶粒生长并丰富星系周介质。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: JWST imaging and spectroscopy of UDS-27023 (catalog ) . Top: \(2\arcsec\times 2\arcsec\) JWST/NIRCam cutouts in the available filters and an RGB composite (left), showing that the source is compact and dominated by a point source in all bands. Bottom: JWST/NIRSpec PRISM spectrum (black) overlaid with the NIRCam photometry (blue hexagons), illustrating the bright continuum and strong broad emission lines characteristic of a Type I QSO. The spectrum shows a strongly suppressed rest-frame UV continuum relative to the rest-frame optical emission, suggesting an exceptionally steep extinction curve. Inset: Zoom-in on the G395H/F290LP spectrum around H \(\alpha\) , together with a multi-component fit (solid red; dashed components). The spectroscopic redshift of UDS-27023 (catalog ) is measured to be \(z=4.556\pm 0.003\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图1：UDS-27023（目录）的JWST成像和光谱。顶部：在可用滤光片下的\(2\arcsec\times 2\arcsec\) JWST/NIRCam剪裁图像和一张RGB合成图（左），显示该源结构紧凑，在所有波段均以点源为主。底部：JWST/NIRSpec PRISM光谱（黑色）叠加了NIRCam测光数据（蓝色六边形），展示了I型类星体特征的明亮连续谱和强宽发射线。相对于静止系光学辐射，该光谱显示出强烈抑制的静止系紫外连续谱，暗示存在异常陡峭的消光曲线。插图：G395H/F290LP光谱在H \(\alpha\) 附近的放大图，以及一个多分量拟合（红色实线；虚线分量）。UDS-27023（目录）的光谱红移测量值为\(z=4.556\pm 0.003\)。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Rest-frame SED and inferred line-of-sight extinction curve of UDS-27023 (catalog ) . Left: Rest-frame UV–optical–NIR spectrum of UDS-27023 (catalog ) (red) compared to an intrinsic blue-QSO composite (blue). The orange curve shows the spectrum corrected using the best-fit extinction curve, illustrating that the dereddened continuum approaches the intrinsic QSO template over the wavelength range. Right: Extinction curve reconstructed for UDS-27023 (catalog ) shown as \(A_{\lambda}/A_{{V}}\) versus wavenumber ( \(1/\lambda\) ; thick red curve), with the shaded red band indicating the corresponding best-fit parametric extinction model with uncertainty. For comparison, we plot the Milky Way and SMC extinction curves, the Calzetti et al. ( 2000 ) starburst attenuation law, the average QSO extinction curve (Temple et al. , 2021 ) , and the set of attenuation curves measured for JWST galaxies at \(z>4\) by Markov et al. 2025 (thin grey curves). Vertical shaded bands mark the \(V\) band and rest-frame 3000 Å and 1500 Å ; the location of the 2175 Å bump is indicated for reference. The SEQ extinction curve rises substantially more steeply into the UV than any of these commonly used laws.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：UDS-27023（目录）的静止系SED和推断的视线方向消光曲线。左图：UDS-27023（目录）的静止系紫外-光学-近红外光谱（红色）与一个本征蓝色类星体复合模板（蓝色）的比较。橙色曲线显示了使用最佳拟合消光曲线校正后的光谱，说明消光校正后的连续谱在波长范围内接近本征类星体模板。右图：为UDS-27023（目录）重建的消光曲线，表示为\(A_{\lambda}/A_{{V}}\) 与波数（\(1/\lambda\)）的关系（粗红色曲线），红色阴影带表示相应的最佳拟合参数化消光模型及其不确定性。作为比较，我们绘制了银河系和小麦哲伦云的消光曲线、Calzetti等人（2000）的星暴衰减律、平均类星体消光曲线（Temple等人，2021），以及Markov等人（2025）为\(z>4\)的JWST星系测量的一组衰减曲线（细灰色曲线）。垂直阴影带标记了\(V\)波段以及静止系3000 Å和1500 Å；2175 Å隆起的位置也标出以供参考。SEQ消光曲线在紫外区域的上升幅度比这些常用定律中的任何一个都陡峭得多。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Physical interpretation and context for the steep extinction toward UDS-27023 (catalog ) . Left: Location of SEQ (red symbol) in the plane of dust-law steepness, \(S\equiv A_{1500}/A_{{V}}\) , versus \(A_{{V}}\) . The grey-scale background shows the distribution of dust attenuation slopes inferred for SDSS galaxies from the GSWLC survey (Salim et al. , 2016 , 2018 ) , and the blue points show the \(z\approx 2\) –10 JWST galaxy attenuation constraints from Markov et al. ( 2025 ) . Horizontal dashed lines indicate the values expected for standard Milky Way and SMC extinction curves, illustrating that SEQ lies at significantly larger \(S\) than both typical low- and high-redshift galaxy extinction and attenuation laws at moderate \(A_{{V}}\) . Right: Comparison of the SEQ extinction curve (red band; normalized at V-band) to common empirical laws (MW and SMC) and to illustrative MRN grain-size models (Mathis et al. , 1977 ) computed from optical properties of silicate and graphite (Draine and Lee, 1984 ; Weingartner and Draine, 2001 ; Laor and Draine, 1993 ) . The grey curves show an MRN-like size distribution ( \(dn/da\propto a^{-3.5}\) ) with a standard silicate+graphite mixture (solid) and silicate-only dust (dashed). Colored curves demonstrate how varying the size-distribution slope \(q\) (defined by \(dn/da\propto a^{-q}\) ) changes the UV rise: small-grain–weighted distributions (larger \(q\) ) produce substantially steeper far-UV extinction than large-grain/gray cases (smaller \(q\) ). The green dotted line denotes a CGM dust extinction curve with a steep slope (Sun et al. , 2026 ) at \(z=3.5\) . Vertical bands mark rest-frame 3000 Å and 1500 Å and the \(V\) band. Together, these panels show that SEQ probes an extreme, line-of-sight extinction law, qualitatively consistent with a dust population strongly weighted toward small grains.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：对UDS-27023（目录）陡峭消光的物理解释和背景。左图：SEQ（红色符号）在尘埃律陡度\(S\equiv A_{1500}/A_{{V}}\) 与\(A_{{V}}\) 平面中的位置。灰色刻度背景显示了GSWLC巡天（Salim等人，2016，2018）推断的SDSS星系尘埃衰减斜率分布，蓝色点显示了Markov等人（2025）对\(z\approx 2\) –10 JWST星系的衰减约束。水平虚线表示标准银河系和小麦哲伦云消光曲线的预期值，说明在中等\(A_{{V}}\) 下，SEQ的\(S\) 值显著大于典型的低红移和高红移星系消光及衰减律。右图：SEQ消光曲线（红色带；在V波段归一化）与常见经验定律（银河系和小麦哲伦云）以及基于硅酸盐和石墨光学性质（Draine and Lee, 1984；Weingartner and Draine, 2001；Laor and Draine, 1993）计算的说明性MRN颗粒尺寸模型（Mathis等人，1977）的比较。灰色曲线显示了具有标准硅酸盐+石墨混合物（实线）和仅硅酸盐尘埃（虚线）的MRN-like尺寸分布（\(dn/da\propto a^{-3.5}\)）。彩色曲线展示了改变尺寸分布斜率\(q\)（定义为\(dn/da\propto a^{-q}\)）如何改变紫外上升：小颗粒加权分布（较大的\(q\)）产生的远紫外消光比大颗粒/灰色情况（较小的\(q\)）陡峭得多。绿色虚线表示红移\(z=3.5\)处具有陡峭斜率的CGM尘埃消光曲线（Sun等人，2026）。垂直带标记了静止系3000 Å和1500 Å以及\(V\)波段。这些图共同表明，SEQ探测到一种极端的视线方向消光律，在定性上与强烈偏向小颗粒的尘埃种群一致。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Schematic illustration of the origin, distribution, and fate of small dust grains in the steep-extinction QSO. Left (Origin): In the early Universe, dust is predominantly injected as large grains by core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe), with minor contributions from AGB stars. Small grains may then be produced through two rapid channels in the QSO environment. In the first pathway, violent feedback drives grain–grain collisions, mechanically shattering large grains into small fragments. In the second pathway, silicate grains may condense in situ within dense QSO-driven winds. Middle (Distribution): The JWST line of sight probes through the circumnuclear region, the host galaxy’s interstellar medium (ISM), and the circumgalactic medium (CGM), directly detecting the steep extinction signature of an abundant small-grain population against the background QSO continuum. Right (Fate): These small grains face three primary evolutionary pathways: they may be destroyed via thermal sputtering in hot, shock-heated gas; they may remain locked in the ISM to facilitate subsequent molecular-cloud and star formation; or they may be entrained in cool-phase outflows and transported to the CGM, populating the extended, small-grain-rich halos recently observed around massive galaxies at high redshift.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：陡消光类星体中尘埃小颗粒的起源、分布和归宿的示意图。左图（起源）：在早期宇宙中，尘埃主要由核心坍缩超新星（CCSNe）以大颗粒形式注入，AGB恒星的贡献较小。小颗粒随后可能通过类星体环境中的两个快速通道产生。在第一条路径中，剧烈的反馈驱动颗粒-颗粒碰撞，将大颗粒机械破碎成小碎片。在第二条路径中，硅酸盐颗粒可能在致密的类星体驱动风中原位凝结。中图（分布）：JWST的视线穿过核周区域、宿主星系的星际介质（ISM）和星系周介质（CGM），直接探测到背景类星体连续谱上丰富小颗粒群的陡峭消光特征。右图（归宿）：这些小颗粒面临三种主要的演化路径：它们可能在热的、激波加热的气体中被热溅射摧毁；它们可能被锁定在ISM中，以促进随后的分子云和恒星形成；或者它们可能被卷入冷相外流并输送到CGM，从而填充最近在高红移大质量星系周围观测到的、富含小颗粒的延展晕。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Photometric selection biases induced by SEQ-like extinction. Left: A set of illustrative JWST/NIRCam color–color diagrams demonstrating that UDS-27023 (catalog ) (red symbol) lies outside common loci for AGN and QSOs in multiple color spaces. Colored tracks show synthetic colors for an intrinsic QSO composite (Selsing et al. , 2016 ) , representative LRD-like colors (Zhang et al. , 2025 ) , and the SEQ extinction model, evaluated as a function of redshift (color-coded). The grey background indicates the distribution of field sources from the JADES survey (Robertson et al. , 2026 ) in the same diagrams. Right: UVJ diagram adapted from Fig. 2 of Carnall et al. ( 2020 ) , illustrating possible misclassification of SEQ under an incorrect low-redshift interpretation. We overlay the inferred UVJ track of UDS-27023 (catalog ) when forced to \(z=2\) –3 (color-coded by assumed redshift) in galaxy-only SED fitting. It falls within the standard UVJ-quiescent selection region (within black solid lines), consistent with its previous identification as a candidate of \(z\approx 2.5\) quiescent galaxy.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：由SEQ-like消光引起的光度选择偏差。左图：一组说明性的JWST/NIRCam颜色-颜色图，显示UDS-27023（目录）（红色符号）在多个颜色空间中位于AGN和类星体的常见区域之外。彩色轨迹显示了本征类星体复合模板（Selsing等人，2016）、代表性的LRD-like颜色（Zhang等人，2025）以及SEQ消光模型的合成颜色，这些颜色是红移的函数（按颜色编码）。灰色背景显示了JADES巡天（Robertson等人，2026）中相同图上的场源分布。右图：改编自Carnall等人（2020）图2的UVJ图，说明了在错误的低红移解释下SEQ可能被错误分类。我们叠加了UDS-27023（目录）在强制假设红移\(z=2\) –3时（按假设红移颜色编码）在仅星系SED拟合中推断出的UVJ轨迹。它落在标准UVJ静止星系选择区域内（黑色实线内），与其先前被识别为\(z\approx 2.5\)静止星系候选体的情况一致。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Photometric redshift and SED modeling on the JWST photometry for UDS-27023 (catalog ) using the Prospector code, still revealing a quiescent/post-starburst galaxy at \(z_{{phot}}\approx 2.6\) . Left: Observed spectrum (thin red line) and photometry (filled red circles with error bars) compared with the best-fit Prospector model spectrum (thick black line) and synthetic photometry (open cyan squares). Fit residuals \(\chi\) are shown in the lower panel, with total \(\chi^{2}\) values for the fit indicated. Top right: Posterior star-formation rate (SFR) as a function of lookback time. Bottom right: Photometric redshift probability distribution \(P(z)\) . The spectroscopic redshift \(z_{{spec}}=4.556\) is marked by the vertical red dashed line.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：使用Prospector代码对UDS-27023（目录）的JWST测光数据进行的光度红移和SED建模，仍然揭示出一个红移\(z_{{phot}}\approx 2.6\)的静止/后星暴星系。左图：观测光谱（细红线）和测光数据（带误差棒的红色实心圆）与最佳拟合Prospector模型光谱（粗黑线）和合成测光数据（青色空心方块）的比较。拟合残差\(\chi\) 显示在下面板中，并标出了拟合的总\(\chi^{2}\) 值。右上图：恒星形成率（SFR）作为回溯时间的后验分布。右下图：光度红移概率分布\(P(z)\)。光谱红移\(z_{{spec}}=4.556\) 由红色垂直虚线标出。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们报告了在欧几里得卫星首批数据发布中发现的两个盘状巨星系。这些源是位于中等红移（$z\sim 0.75$）强超密区域中的大质量（$M>10^{11} M_\odot$）恒星形成盘（恒星形成率 $\sim 20 M_\odot$/年）。它们代表了超密区域中大质量星系的一小部分（在本研究分析的超过20平方度中仅有四个候选体），并且考虑到在低红移的星系群和星系团中心通常存在被动且由核球主导的源，它们的存在令人费解。首先，我们的分析表明这些天体位于大质量星系群（$M_h\sim 10^{13.8} M_\odot$）中，在那里，静态热晕的形成应阻止冷气体的快速吸积。尽管如此，利用NOEMA进行的毫米波后续观测显示这些源内部存在显著的冷气体储库（$M_{h_2} \sim 10^{10.3} M_\odot$）。其次，我们的形态学分析显示这些星系中存在一个大质量且被动的核球，这预计会稳定盘面以防止碎裂，从而抑制进一步的恒星形成。然而，这些源位于Schmidt-Kennicutt关系上甚至略高于该关系。基于这些观测，我们提出了一种情景，即这些盘状巨星系是合并诱导的再 rejuvenation 事件的产物，在该事件中，星系群中最亮的星系从另一个成员星系吸积冷气体并短暂地重新启动恒星形成。通过与TNG300模拟的比较，这一情景得到了支持，并很容易将超密环境中大质量星系中恒星形成活动的存续解释为更复杂演化中的暂态阶段。更广泛地说，我们的研究展示了欧几里得卫星凭借其巡天提供的空前统计量以及欧几里得与其他更长波长观测设施之间的协同作用所具有的科学潜力，从而发现稀有天体的能力。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，提出合并诱导的再 rejuvenation 场景：群中最亮星系通过吸积伴星冷气体短暂重启恒星形成。这类星系代表了高密度环境中大质量星系演化的暂态阶段，展示了欧几里得卫星结合多波段观测发现稀有天体能力。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Colour-composite images of the two targets analysed in this paper and the surrounding environments. Each large image covers one square arcminute, with a side roughly corresponding to \(441\) proper \({kpc}\) at \(z\sim 0.7\) and it is obtained through the Lupton_01 algorithm by combining the \(I_{\scriptscriptstyleE}\) , \(Y_{\scriptscriptstyleE}\) , and \(H_{\scriptscriptstyleE}\) images. The white curves are the galaxy density field in units of \(\sigma\) above the median starting from \(3\sigma\) . The candidate members (i.e., with a redshift compatible with the over-density and with a density contrast higher than \(3\sigma\) ) are marked with red crosses. The inner panels report a zoom on the two disky titans, with sides of \(20\arcsec\times 20\arcsec\) . These images are generated with Jafar 2 2 2 https://jafar.astro.unistra.fr/ to highlight low surface brightness features by combining the four Euclid bands.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：本文分析的两个目标及其周围环境的彩色合成图像。每张大图覆盖一角分见方，边长在$z\sim 0.7$处大致对应\(441\) 本征\({kpc}\)，通过结合\(I_{\scriptscriptstyleE}\)、\(Y_{\scriptscriptstyleE}\)和\(H_{\scriptscriptstyleE}\)图像，使用Lupton_01算法获得。白色曲线是以中位数以上\(\sigma\)为单位的星系密度场，从\(3\sigma\)开始。候选成员（即红移与超密区域一致且密度对比高于\(3\sigma\)的星系）用红色十字标记。内部面板显示两个盘状巨星系的放大图，边长为\(20\arcsec\times 20\arcsec\)。这些图像通过结合四个欧几里得波段，使用Jafar 2 2 2 https://jafar.astro.unistra.fr/ 生成，以突出低表面亮度特征。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Diffuse X-ray emission of the massive group hosting DT-2 as observed by XMM-Newton. The contours show the X-ray emission in the soft band ( \(0.5\mbox{--}2\,{keV}\) ) in units of \(\sigma\) above the median, starting from \(5\sigma\) and with steps of \(2\sigma\) . The X-ray spectrum is consistent with thermal Bremsstrahlung with \(T\sim 4\times 10^{6}\,{K}\) and a total \(L_{X}\sim 2\times 10^{43}\,{erg\,s^{-1}}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图6：XMM-Newton观测到的宿主DT-2的大质量星系群的弥散X射线发射。等值线显示了软波段（\(0.5\mbox{--}2\,{keV}\)）中高于中位数、以\(\sigma\)为单位的X射线发射，从\(5\sigma\)开始，步长为\(2\sigma\)。X射线谱与温度为\(T\sim 4\times 10^{6}\,{K}\)、总\(L_{X}\sim 2\times 10^{43}\,{erg\,s^{-1}}\)的热轫致辐射一致。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 星际介质的观测和模拟均表明，磁场在纤维结构的形成与演化以及恒星形成过程中起着关键作用，但其确切作用仍知之甚少。本文旨在统计研究具有不同物理性质和银河系环境的多个恒星形成区域中纤维结构与磁场之间的相对取向。我们使用专用方法FilDReaMS在多尺度上检测和提取纤维结构，并将其应用于赫歇尔“银河冷核”关键项目（分辨率18"-36"）的116个天区。随后，我们将纤维取向与普朗克观测（分辨率7'）推断的平面天空磁场（B_PoS）取向进行比较，采用相对取向直方图（HRO）进行分析。我们发现，低N_H2纤维在所有尺度上大致平行于B_PoS，而窄的高N_H2纤维没有优先取向，宽的高N_H2纤维则大致垂直于B_PoS。这种优先取向的变化发生在典型柱密度范围[0.8, 8] × 10^{21} cm^{-2}内，该范围与先前普朗克研究的结果一致。我们还分析了含有嵌入核的纤维的HRO，发现其与高N_H2纤维的HRO一致。然而，部分天区不遵循总体趋势，表现出多种行为，可能由投影效应、视线方向混淆或磁场缠结等因素导致。我们对投影效应的分析表明，统计上，平面天空中的优先取向反映了三维空间中的真实优先取向。我们的结果表明，更高的极化分数p对应更弱的投影效应，这与p与磁场视线方向倾角之间的假定关联一致。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，研究结果支持磁场在星际纤维演化中的关键作用，更高的极化分数p对应更弱的投影效应，验证了p与磁场视线方向倾角之间的关联。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 活动星系核（AGN）喷流辐射的射电同步辐射呈现出多种形态。同时，它们提供热量以防止冷团星系团中的冷却流。我们针对一个自调控的冷团星系团中的AGN喷流，生成了模拟射电观测。为此，我们采用了一个理想化的类英仙座星系团的磁流体动力学模拟，其中吸积驱动的低密度喷流通过次网格模型加速宇宙线质子和电子。宇宙线电子谱沿拉格朗日示踪粒子轨迹，使用福克-普朗克求解器Crest进行空间和时间演化，以产生射电同步辐射。自调控的AGN喷流稳定了冷团星系团，防止了冷却流，并产生了真实的范德瑞-莱利I型（FRI）和受扰动的瓣状形态，这与固定功率的单次喷流爆发产生的对称瓣状结构形成对比。我们的模拟射电观测以耀变体构型——沿喷流轴方向——进行观测，尽管这样，仍显示出复杂的射电辐射瓣结构。这突显了冷气体结构对轻喷流的强烈偏转，并表明小尺度黑洞和喷流特性无法从kpc尺度的FRI射电瓣形态推断出来。结合自洽演化的磁场和电子谱，使我们能够解释一个已知的观测现象，即星系团尺度上AGN瓣的射电观测偶尔在不同频率下显示出相似的空间范围：在我们冷团环境中获得的1-50 μG磁场中，新加速的和已有数亿年历史的电子都能对150 MHz - 1.4 GHz频率范围做出贡献。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，结论如下：轻喷流被冷气体结构强烈偏转，小尺度黑洞与喷流特性无法从kpc尺度的FRI射电瓣形态推断；自洽演化的磁场和电子谱能解释观测中不同频率射电瓣范围相似的现象。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Projections of self-regulated AGN jets in a Perseus-like galaxy cluster at \(t=1.44\) Gyr. Top: From left to right, volume-weighted gas mass density, magnetic field strength, CR proton energy density, and the CR electron energy density multiplied by \(1/\xi_{{cre}}=100\) , where \(\xi_{{cre}}\) is our chosen efficiency of CR proton to CR electron energy conversion (Sect. 2.5.1 ). Bottom: From left to right, we show the volume-weighted jet tracer \(X_{{jet}}\) , the magnetic-to-thermal pressure ratio \(X_{B}\) , and the CR proton to thermal pressure ratio \(X_{{crp}}\) , all calculated using volume-weighted pressures. The last panel shows the radio intensity at 150 MHz obtained from CR electron spectra calculated with the Fokker-Planck solver Crest , smoothed with a 2D Gaussian beam with full-width at half-maximum \({FWHM}=4\) kpc. The low-density jet-inflated lobes of different shapes and sizes are filled with CRs. The radio intensity at 150 MHz primarily highlights the ongoing jet outburst, but previous outbursts are visible in the CR distributions.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：在类英仙座星系团中，自调控AGN喷流在\(t=1.44\) Gyr时的投影。上排：从左到右，分别为体积加权的气体质量密度、磁场强度、CR质子能量密度，以及乘以\(1/\xi_{{cre}}=100\)的CR电子能量密度，其中\(\xi_{{cre}}\)是我们选择的CR质子到CR电子能量转换效率（第2.5.1节）。下排：从左到右，我们展示了体积加权的喷流示踪剂\(X_{{jet}}\)、磁压与热压之比\(X_{B}\)，以及CR质子与热压之比\(X_{{crp}}\)，所有比值均使用体积加权压力计算。最后一个面板显示了使用福克-普朗克求解器Crest计算的CR电子谱在150 MHz处的射电强度，并用半高全宽\({FWHM}=4\) kpc的二维高斯波束进行了平滑。不同形状和大小的低密度喷流充气瓣中充满了CRs。150 MHz的射电强度主要突出了正在进行的喷流爆发，但之前的爆发在CR分布中仍然可见。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Synchrotron intensity maps at \(150\) MHz of self-regulated AGN jets at different epochs, in comparison with the single jet outburst in the bottom right corner presented in J26 . We smooth the image using a symmetric 2D beam with FWHM \(=7\arcsec\approx 2.7\,{kpc}\) (depicted in panel A at the bottom right) to mock observationally motivated angular resolutions, and use the conversion \(1\,{Jy}\,{beam}^{-1}=0.018\,{Jy}\,{arcsec}^{-2}\) . We draw contours at \(\sigma_{{LoTSS}}\times[3,100,800]\) , where \(\sigma_{{LoTSS}}=100\,\mu{Jy/beam}\) is the sensitivity achieved in LoTSS. These contour levels are also marked in the colour bar as vertical lines. We obtain mock radio maps of FRI-like jets, and lobes with complex, asymmetrical structures. This in contrast to the simulation of a single jet outburst, which solely produces symmetrical, polar lobes.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：不同时期自调控AGN喷流在\(150\) MHz处的同步辐射强度图，与J26中展示的右下角单次喷流爆发进行比较。我们使用FWHM \(=7\arcsec\approx 2.7\,{kpc}\)的对称二维波束（如面板A右下角所示）对图像进行平滑，以模拟观测驱动的角分辨率，并使用转换关系\(1\,{Jy}\,{beam}^{-1}=0.018\,{Jy}\,{arcsec}^{-2}\)。我们绘制了\(\sigma_{{LoTSS}}\times[3,100,800]\)的等值线，其中\(\sigma_{{LoTSS}}=100\,\mu{Jy/beam}\)是LoTSS达到的灵敏度。这些等值线水平也在色条中以垂直线标出。我们获得了类似FRI喷流以及具有复杂、不对称结构的瓣的模拟射电图。这与仅产生对称极向瓣的单次喷流爆发模拟形成对比。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Synchrotron intensity maps projected along three different axes at \(150\) MHz of a single snapshot at \(t=1.46\) Gyr (see movie ), and smoothed with a 2D Gaussian beam \({FWHM}=4\) kpc. The cartoon in the upper right illustrates the jet launching direction. The bottom left image in the cube is obtained by projecting along the jet launching axis, as is the case for the mock images shown in Fig. 2 . This viewing direction corresponds to a blazar-like configuration, despite which we observe clear jet-inflated lobes. This demonstrates the deflection experienced by the jets on kpc-scales, caused by cold gas structures forming in the cluster centre and accreted onto the SMBH.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：在\(t=1.46\) Gyr的单个快照（见影片）中，沿三个不同轴投影的\(150\) MHz同步辐射强度图，并使用\({FWHM}=4\) kpc的二维高斯波束进行平滑。右上角的示意图说明了喷流发射方向。立方体中的左下角图像是沿喷流发射轴投影得到的，与图2中显示的模拟图像情况相同。这个观测方向对应于类似耀变体的构型，尽管如此，我们仍观察到清晰的喷流充气瓣。这证明了喷流在kpc尺度上经历的偏转，是由星系团中心形成并吸积到超大质量黑洞上的冷气体结构引起的。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Bottom: Time evolution of the jet luminosity (black line) and 1.4 GHz radio luminosity (coloured line). The black and red dashed lines indicate the mean jet and radio luminosities, respectively. The jets are initially in an ‘intermittent’ phase with short, weak outbursts ( \(\leq 0.9\) Gyr) and transition into a ‘maintenance’-phase where the outbursts are powerful and almost continuous ( \(>0.9\) Gyr). Top left: Time evolution of the volume-weighted non-thermal electron spectra. In the first Gyr, the sparse jet outbursts lead to a strongly-cooled CR electron spectrum as a result of Coulomb and radiative losses. Once the AGN jets enter a maintenance phase with almost continuous outbursts, the high momentum part of the spectrum exhibits a steady-state slope as new electrons are accelerated. Top right: Time evolution of the total radio luminosity between 10 MHz and 100 GHz computed from the electron spectra. The vertical dashed line indicates the \(\nu=150\) MHz frequency, and the horizontal dashed line the FRI-FRII radio power divide observed at this frequency (Mingo et al. 2019 ) . The spectral evolution over time is analogous to that of the CR electron spectrum.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：下排：喷流光度（黑线）和1.4 GHz射电光度（彩色线）的时间演化。黑色和红色虚线分别表示平均喷流和射电光度。喷流最初处于一个‘间歇’阶段，具有短暂、微弱的爆发（\(\leq 0.9\) Gyr），然后过渡到一个‘维持’阶段，其中爆发强烈且几乎连续（\(>0.9\) Gyr）。左上：体积加权非热电子谱的时间演化。在第一个Gyr中，稀疏的喷流爆发导致CR电子谱因库仑和辐射损失而强烈冷却。一旦AGN喷流进入几乎连续爆发的维持阶段，谱的高动量部分由于新电子被加速而呈现出稳态斜率。右上：根据电子谱计算的10 MHz至100 GHz总射电光度的时间演化。垂直虚线表示\(\nu=150\) MHz频率，水平虚线表示在该频率观测到的FRI-FRII射电功率分界（Mingo et al. 2019）。谱随时间的演化与CR电子谱的演化类似。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Spatial and spectral distributions of different electron ages, defined as the time since last injection \(t_{{since\,inj}}\) , at \(t=1.5\) Gyr. We differentiate between young (age \(\leq 4\) Myr) and old ( \(4 Right: Spatial distributions of CR electron tracer particles, colour-coded by their age, i.e. their corresponding time since injection. Left, top row: CR electron spectra colour-coded by the time since injection. Using the 10-90th percentiles of the magnetic field strength distribution, we plot the electron momentum contributing to the 150 MHz and 1.4 GHz emissions in light and dark grey, respectively. We show the global spectrum at the snapshot time as a dotted black line, and the cumulative spectra composed of the electron populations showed in each panel using a dashed black line. Left, bottom row: Corresponding synchrotron radio spectra. High momenta ( \(p>10^{5}\) ) are dominated by electrons undergoing acceleration. Low and mid-momenta ( \(p<10^{4}\) ) are dominated by old electrons. Both young and old CR electrons contribute to the intermediate momentum range \(10^{3}<p<10^{4}\) , which is precisely the range which contributes to emission in the 150 MHz – 1.4 GHz band.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：在\(t=1.5\) Gyr时，不同电子年龄（定义为自上次注入以来的时间\(t_{{since\,inj}}\)）的空间和谱分布。我们区分年轻（年龄\(\leq 4\) Myr）和年老（\(4 < t_{{since\,inj}} \leq 100\) Myr）的电子。右图：CR电子示踪粒子的空间分布，按其年龄（即自注入以来的相应时间）着色。左图，上排：按自注入以来时间着色的CR电子谱。使用磁场强度分布的10-90百分位数，我们分别用浅灰色和深灰色绘制了贡献于150 MHz和1.4 GHz发射的电子动量。我们将快照时刻的全局谱显示为黑色虚线，并将每个面板中显示的电子种群组成的累积谱显示为黑色虚线。左图，下排：相应的同步辐射射电谱。高动量（\(p>10^{5}\)）区域由正在经历加速的电子主导。低和中等动量（\(p<10^{4}\)）区域由年老电子主导。年轻和年老的CR电子都对中间动量范围\(10^{3}<p<10^{4}\)有贡献，而这正是对150 MHz – 1.4 GHz波段发射有贡献的范围。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Multi-panel view of the AGN jet outburst at \(t=1.5\) Gyr (same time as Fig. 5 ). Central column: From top to bottom, we show the 150 MHz radio intensity, the spectral index map at 150 MHz – 1.4 GHz, and the 1.4 GHz intensity. The radio mocks are smoothed with a Gaussian beam with \({FHWM}=4\) kpc, from which the spectral index map is computed. The multi-epoch radio intensity at these two frequencies is shown in a movie . Left and right columns: CR electron spectra and corresponding radio synchrotron spectra in four different regions of interest. Each box has dimensions \(30\times 30\,{kpc}^{2}\) , and the same depth as the radio images. The 10–90th percentile magnetic field strengths within these boxes is used to show the momenta contributing to the 150 MHz and 1.4 GHz emission frequencies in light and dark gray, respectively. The similar features observed in the jet lobes at low and high frequencies are explained by the contributing momenta highlighting both old and young electrons (see Fig. 5 ). Regions a) and b) are composed of old electron populations whose cut-off momentum \(p\approx 10^{4}\) is in the band of contributing momenta, which is why these electrons are visible at 150 MHz, but not at 1.4 GHz. Regions c) and d) include younger electrons in comparison to regions a) and b), indicated by the power-law shape in region c) and d).
figures.caption_zh: 图6：在\(t=1.5\) Gyr时AGN喷流爆发的多面板视图（与图5相同时间）。中间列：从上到下，我们展示了150 MHz射电强度、150 MHz – 1.4 GHz谱指数图以及1.4 GHz强度。射电模拟图使用\({FHWM}=4\) kpc的高斯波束进行平滑，并据此计算谱指数图。这两个频率的多时期射电强度在影片中展示。左列和右列：四个不同感兴趣区域中的CR电子谱和相应的射电同步辐射谱。每个方框的尺寸为\(30\times 30\,{kpc}^{2}\)，深度与射电图像相同。使用这些方框内磁场强度的10-90百分位数，分别用浅灰色和深灰色显示贡献于150 MHz和1.4 GHz发射频率的动量。喷流瓣在低频和高频观测到的相似特征可以通过贡献动量同时突出年老和年轻电子来解释（见图5）。区域a)和b)由年老电子种群组成，其截止动量\(p\approx 10^{4}\)位于贡献动量带内，这就是为什么这些电子在150 MHz可见，但在1.4 GHz不可见。区域c)和d)包含比区域a)和b)更年轻的电子，由区域c)和d)中的幂律形状指示。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Time evolution of the cumulative jet, CR proton, and CR electron energies. Protons are transported through advection and diffusion, and cooled through Coulomb, hadronic, and Alfvén losses. The electrons are transported strictly through advection, and cooled through Coulomb and radiative (bremsstrahlung, synchrotron and IC) losses. The different loss processes experienced by CR protons and electrons explain the differently decreasing CR proton and electron energies over time.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：累积的喷流、CR质子和CR电子能量的时间演化。质子通过平流和扩散输运，并通过库仑、强子和阿尔文损失冷却。电子严格通过平流输运，并通过库仑和辐射（轫致辐射、同步辐射和逆康普顿散射）损失冷却。CR质子和电子经历的不同损失过程解释了CR质子和电子能量随时间的不同下降趋势。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8: Time evolution of cold gas mass \(M_{{cold}}\) ( \(T 0.9\) Gyr, in the maintenance phase where the jet is continuously on.
figures.caption_zh: 图8：冷气体质量\(M_{{cold}}\)（\(T < 10^{5}\) K）和冷气体吸积率\(\dot{M}_{{cold}}\)的时间演化。冷气体质量在第一个Gyr中增加，然后随着喷流进入维持阶段而减少。冷气体吸积率在间歇阶段（\(<0.9\) Gyr）较高，在维持阶段（\(>0.9\) Gyr）较低，此时喷流持续开启。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用Abell 2744场中最深的光谱确认的强[OIII]$+$H$β$发射线星系样本（静止系等值宽度$>740$ Å）量化了$z\sim7$处的电离光子产生率。借助超深UNCOVER F410M成像（$5\sigma\sim29$ AB）和引力透镜效应，我们探测的深度比之前的JWST WFSS [OIII]研究高出一个数量级，达到了光度极限$\log(L_{\rm{[OIII]}+\rm{H}β}/\text{erg s}^{-1})=41.3$。我们的静止系光学发射线选择探测到了一些最年轻、金属和尘埃贫乏的星系，识别出大量连续谱微弱、电离候选体。对光度代表性子样本的NIRSpec后续观测确认了$72\%$的目标，提供了18个发射体的详细表征。巴尔默减缩显示尘埃可忽略不计，而强线诊断表明金属丰度极低（$12+\log(\text{O/H})=6.8\text{--}7.7$）。典型的[OII]/[OIII]比值为$0.054\pm0.007$，我们推断平均莱曼连续谱逃逸分数接近典型值$f_{\text{esc}}=20\%$。根据光谱确认率进行校正后，我们发现这些高等值宽度发射体在数密度上占整个紫外选择星系的$56\pm12\%$。积分到我们的巡天极限，这些发射体的电离预算（$\log(\dot{N}_{\rm ion}/{\rm s}^{-1}\,\text{Mpc}^{-3})=50.63\pm0.05$）约占$z\sim7$再电离所需总预算的$\sim70\%$。这一结果与经验基准一致。这些结果确立了[OIII]$+$H$β$选择作为一种强有力的、不受尘埃影响的探测手段，表明已知的星系群体在再电离过程中发挥着主导作用。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有总结：[OIII]+Hβ选择是一种强有力的、不受尘埃影响的探测手段，表明已知的星系群体在再电离过程中发挥着主导作用。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 高红移恒星形成星系（SFGs）中千秒差距尺度团块的物理性质对其如何组装提供了关键约束。基于近期研究表明团块星系与非团块SFGs相比存在金属丰度偏移，我们利用LEGA-C、MOSDEF和CANUCS近红外光谱观测，分析了0.6<z<2.6之间约300个SFGs大样本中的化学丰度。我们发现，团块星系通常具有比质量-金属丰度关系更低的气相金属丰度，而非团块星系则具有更高的金属丰度。我们进一步利用CANUCS场中观测到的子样本，研究了团块的分辨恒星性质与宿主星系积分气相金属丰度之间的关系。特别地，在金属丰度低于质量-金属丰度关系（即ΔZ ≤ 0）的SFGs中的团块，通常比宿主星系ΔZ > 0的团块更年轻且具有更高的恒星形成率。我们未发现这两个团块种群之间存在显著的质量差异。最后，我们利用Gini-M20形态参数计算并合统计量，发现大多数团块星系根据其恒星质量图并不被归类为并合星系。结果表明，宇宙正午星系的团块性质与触发恒星形成并稀释金属丰度的金属贫乏气体吸积事件相关。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有总结：团块星系的特征与金属贫乏气体吸积事件相关，这些事件触发恒星形成并稀释金属丰度，而非主要由并合过程驱动。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Examples of 2D spectra and extracted 1D spectra of CANCUS galaxies. Inset figures show the composite NIRCAM image of the galaxy, with the red line denoting the MOSFIRE slit position angle and width. The dark grey regions denote wavelengths affected by strong skylines.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：CANCUS星系的二维光谱和提取的一维光谱示例。插图显示了星系的复合NIRCAM图像，红线表示MOSFIRE狭缝位置角和宽度。深灰色区域表示受强天光影响的波长。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: The mass and SFR distribution of galaxies from LEGA-C, MOSDEF and CANUCS, color coded by redshift. Both stellar mass and SFR are derived from Dense Basis . The star-forming main sequences from Mérida et al. ( 2025 ) are shown as the dashed lines. We do not show a star-forming main sequence for the LEGA-C sample as Mérida et al. ( 2025 ) does not extend below \(z=1\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图2：来自LEGA-C、MOSDEF和CANUCS的星系质量和SFR分布，按红移着色。恒星质量和SFR均来自Dense Basis。来自Mérida等人（2025）的恒星形成主序以虚线显示。我们不显示LEGA-C样本的恒星形成主序，因为Mérida等人（2025）未延伸至\(z=1\)以下。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Examples of the classification of clumpy and nonclumpy galaxies. We show galaxies with increasing fractional \(U_{{rest}}\) luminosity from left to right, with the three left- and right-most galaxies being classified as nonclumpy and clumpy, respectively. Each row further separates galaxies by the different redshift intervals sampled by the different surveys. Each cutout is \(3.6^{\prime\prime}\times 3.6^{\prime\prime}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图3：团块和非团块星系分类示例。我们展示从左到右分数\(U_{{rest}}\)光度递增的星系，最左边三个和最右边三个星系分别被分类为非团块和团块。每一行进一步按不同巡天采样的不同红移区间分隔星系。每个截图为\(3.6^{\prime\prime}\times 3.6^{\prime\prime}\)。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: An example showing how clumps are identified. Clumps are detected based on the high-contrast image. This high-contrast image is obtained by subtracting the rest-frame bright map by its reconstructed smooth image (see § III.1 ). The reconstructed image is shown in the middle left panel. The bottom left panel shows the high-contrast image, while the bottom right shows the detected clumps (circle) and bulge (star).
figures.caption_zh: 图4：团块识别示例。团块基于高对比度图像检测。该高对比度图像通过从静止帧亮图中减去其重建的平滑图像获得（见§ III.1）。重建图像显示在左中面板。左下方面板显示高对比度图像，而右下方面板显示检测到的团块（圆圈）和核球（星形）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: The mass-metallicity relation for the LEGA-C sample using the \(R23\) index. The dotted line shows the best-fit mass-metallicity relation. The right panel shows the empirical cumulative distribution function (eCDF) of the metallicity residual, defined to be \(\Delta Z=Z-{MZR}\) . We find that the eCDF of clumpy galaxies is generally shifted to lower \(\Delta Z\) values compared to nonclumpy galaxies, indicating that clumpy galaxies have metallicity lower than their nonclumpy counterparts.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：使用\(R23\)指数的LEGA-C样本的质量-金属丰度关系。虚线显示最佳拟合的质量-金属丰度关系。右面板显示金属丰度残差的经验累积分布函数（eCDF），定义为\(\Delta Z=Z-{MZR}\)。我们发现，与非团块星系相比，团块星系的eCDF通常向更低的\(\Delta Z\)值偏移，表明团块星系的金属丰度低于其非团块对应体。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Similar to Figure 5 , but for the MOSDEF and CANUCS samples. We show the observed mass-metallicity relation at different redshift bins for each row in the left panels, while the right panels show the eCDF. The best-fit mass-metallicity relation is determined by combining all galaxies between \(1.3 Sanders et al. ( 2018 ) .
figures.caption_zh: 图6：类似于图5，但针对MOSDEF和CANUCS样本。我们在左面板的每一行显示不同红移区间的观测质量-金属丰度关系，而右面板显示eCDF。最佳拟合的质量-金属丰度关系通过结合所有\(1.3<z<2.6\)的星系确定，并参考Sanders等人（2018）的校准。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: The kernel density estimate of clump masses, ages, and SED-derived SFR for clumps in galaxies with \(\Delta Z>0\) (purple) and \(\Delta Z<0\) (green). In general, we find that clumps in galaxies that lie below the mass-metallicity relation are younger and highly star-forming compared to clumps in galaxies that lie above the mass-metallicity relation.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：\(\Delta Z>0\)（紫色）和\(\Delta Z<0\)（绿色）星系中团块质量、年龄和SED推导的SFR的核密度估计。总体而言，我们发现位于质量-金属丰度关系下方的星系中的团块比位于质量-金属丰度关系上方的星系中的团块更年轻且具有更高的恒星形成率。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）发现了一类位于红移 $z \gtrsim 4$ 的“小红点”（LRDs），它们可能代表嵌入致密气体包层中的早期超大质量黑洞。最近对透镜LRD RXJ2211-RX1的观测揭示，其在静止系时标上存在长达数十年的显著光变，这种光变可被解释为准周期变化，其物理机制可能与恒星脉动类似。在本工作中，我们基于流体静力学包层模型推导了一个理想化的、自洽的周期-光度-有效温度（$P$-$L$-$T_{\rm eff}$）关系。如果该理论关系成立，并能够通过经验验证或校准，它将为约束哈勃常数（$H_0$）提供一种新的框架。目前对目标源的稀疏采样给出了一个初步的 $H_0 = 120.7_{-46.5}^{+47.0} \text{ km s}^{-1}\text{ Mpc}^{-1}$ 作为概念验证，其误差主要来自脉动周期的不确定性。我们的预测分析表明，在10年基线内进行连续监测可将 $H_0$ 的不确定性降低至3-20%，具体取决于内在脉动周期，而系统不确定性的本底仍有待全面表征。该方法为测量早期宇宙中的光度距离提供了一种潜在的独立探针。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，该脉动方法有望成为早期宇宙中测量光度距离的独立探针，为哈勃常数测定提供新途径。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Left: Posterior probability density functions (PDF) for the rest-frame period \(P_{src}\) . We consider the approved program GO-10005 and two extended scenarios incorporating additional monitoring over 5-year and 10-year baselines. The uncertainty \(\sigma_{P}\) diminishes with extended monitoring, converging toward the assumed value of 31.8 years. Right: The corresponding constraints on the Hubble constant \(H_{0}\) . Top panel shows the aggregated PDF of \(H_{0}\) derived from different period measurements (correspond to the color in the left panel), showing the significant decrease in uncertainties as monitoring accumulated. Bottom panel shows comparison of \(H_{0}\) measurement precision across different scenarios. The colored points represent our simulated results with \(1\sigma\) uncertainties. Existing constraints (gray squares) including SH0ES [ 51 ] , Planck [ 50 ] , TRGB [ 16 ] , and Strong Lensing [ 57 ] are shown for comparison. The vertical dashed line \(H_{0}=73\text{ km s}^{-1}\text{Mpc}^{-1}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图1：左图：静止系周期 \(P_{src}\) 的后验概率密度函数（PDF）。我们考虑了已批准的GO-10005项目以及两个扩展方案，分别包含5年和10年基线内的额外监测。随着监测时间延长，不确定性 \(\sigma_{P}\) 减小，并收敛至假设值31.8年。右图：对哈勃常数 \(H_{0}\) 的相应约束。上方面板展示了由不同周期测量（对应左图颜色）导出的 \(H_{0}\) 的聚合PDF，显示随着监测积累，不确定性显著降低。下方面板比较了不同场景下 \(H_{0}\) 的测量精度。彩色点代表我们的模拟结果，带有 \(1\sigma\) 不确定性。作为对比，还展示了现有的约束（灰色方块），包括SH0ES [ 51 ] 、Planck [ 50 ] 、TRGB [ 16 ] 和强透镜 [ 57 ] 。垂直虚线为 \(H_{0}=73\text{ km s}^{-1}\text{Mpc}^{-1}\) 。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Posterior probability density functions for the rest-frame period \(P_{src}\) with intrinsic \(P_{src}\) of 27 years (left) and 40 years (right). The additional monitoring configuration is the same as that in Fig. 1 .
figures.caption_zh: 图2：内在周期 \(P_{src}\) 分别为27年（左图）和40年（右图）时，静止系周期 \(P_{src}\) 的后验概率密度函数。额外监测配置与图1相同。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们研究了本地（$z = 0.048$）、红外明亮（$L_{\rm IR} = 10^{11.87}$\,L$_\odot$）的晚期星系并合体IRAS F01364-1042的空间分辨星际介质性质，结合来自\textit{JWST/MIRI-MRS}、ALMA和Keck/KCWI的多波段积分场单元观测。利用这些数据集，我们构建了电离气体（例如[Ne\,II]\,12.8$μ$m、[O\,III]$\lambda5007$）、暖分子气体（例如\ce{H2}\,0-0\,S(3)）和冷分子气体（例如CO (J$=2-1$)）等几个关键示踪物的发射线图，并对发射区域中分辨区域提取的光谱进行了详细分解。我们确认了沿高度倾斜旋转盘短轴方向存在多相星系双锥外流。推断的电离相、暖分子相和冷分子相的外流速度分别为$\sim\,$500 - 600\,km\,s$^{-1}$、$\sim\,$350\,km\,s$^{-1}$和$\sim\,$200 - 300\,km\,s$^{-1}$，相应的质量外流率分别为$\sim 0.3 - 2.3$、$\sim 31$和$\sim 38 - 240$\,M$_\odot\,$yr$^{-1}$。冷分子相在总质量外流率和相关动能（$\sim\,2 - 8 \times 10^{42}$\,erg\,s$^{-1}$）中占主导地位。我们首次通过探测[Ne\,V]\,14.3$μ$m谱线确认了IRAS\,F01364-1042中存在尘埃遮蔽的活动星系核。推断的低AGN热光度（$1.2 - 1.8 \times 10^{43}$\,erg\,s$^{-1}$）表明，仅核星暴（恒星形成率约$40 - 60$\,M$_\odot$\,yr$^{-1}$）就能提供驱动外流所需的能量，尽管近期更活跃的AGN阶段也可能起了作用。我们的工作展示了多波段观测对于解析并合驱动尘埃星暴星系中气体动力学的必要性，以及\textit{JWST/MIRI-MRS}揭示这些系统中可能普遍存在的遮蔽低光度AGN的能力。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，结论如下：核星暴（SFR约40-60 M☉/yr）足以提供驱动外流所需的能量，尽管近期更活跃的AGN也可能起过作用。多波段观测对解析并合驱动尘埃星暴星系的气体动力学至关重要，JWST/MIRI-MRS有能力揭示其中常见的遮蔽低光度AGN。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们提出谱线强度映射（LIM）作为活动星系核（AGN）的一种新探针。通过将[Ne V]强度图与星系红移巡天进行互相关，我们证明即使单个源低于探测阈值，累积的AGN谱线发射也可以被探测到。[Ne V]的97.1 eV电离势使其成为AGN活动基本无污染的示踪物，它产生于窄线区，即使在严重遮蔽的AGN中也可及。我们使用Fisher矩阵形式对两个假设的未来仪器进行信噪比预测：一个针对[Ne V] $λ3426$ 的CDIM类仪器，以及一个针对[Ne V] $14.3 μ$m 优化的PRIMA类LIM仪器。对于CDIM类情况，我们在 $z=2-3$ 范围内发现对平均AGN强度与偏置乘积 $S_{\rm NeV} b_{\rm NeV}$ 的强约束，红移空间畸变使得能够分别约束 $S_{\rm NeV}$ 和 $b_{\rm NeV}$。LIM信号对低于 $5σ$ 直接探测阈值的AGN保持灵敏度，在 $z=3$ 时该阈值对应 $L_{\rm bol} \sim 5\times10^{43}$ erg s$^{-1}$，并与现有光度函数测量的暗弱端重合。总信号中约10%来自低于该阈值的源，在 $z=2-3$ 范围内（对于 $S_{\rm NeV} b_{\rm NeV}$）可探测到次阈值群体，信噪比为 $S/N=9-4$。PRIMA类仪器获得的信噪比略低，但由于 $14.3 μ$m 谱线对尘埃消光不敏感，它提供了AGN群体的互补探针。AGN LIM可潜在地应用于多个科学问题，包括追踪AGN总光度历史、约束暗弱光度下的黑洞-晕关系，以及区分超大质量黑洞种子形成机制。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，AGN谱线强度映射可应用于追踪AGN总光度历史、约束暗弱光度下黑洞-晕关系、区分超大质量黑洞种子形成机制等科学问题。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1 : Cross-power spectrum at \(z=3\) for a CDIM-like survey targeting [Ne v ] \(\lambda 3426\) . Error bars show the \(1\sigma\) uncertainties and data points denote central values of the assumed k-bins. Note that we conservatively do not include redshift-space distortions here, but that they are considered in the Fisher matrix calculation described in the main text.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：针对[Ne v ] \(\lambda 3426\) 的CDIM类巡天在 \(z=3\) 处的交叉功率谱。误差棒表示 \(1\sigma\) 不确定性，数据点表示假设的k-bin的中心值。注意，我们在此保守地未包含红移空间畸变，但它们在正文描述的Fisher矩阵计算中已被考虑。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2 : Signal-to-noise on \(S_{NeV}b_{NeV}\) as a function of redshift for a CDIM-like survey cross-correlating galaxies and [Ne v ] \(\lambda 3426\) . Both the total AGN population (solid line) and the population below the CDIM 5 \(\sigma\) direct detection limit (dotted line) are shown.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：针对CDIM类巡天对星系和[Ne v ] \(\lambda 3426\) 进行互相关时， \(S_{NeV}b_{NeV}\) 的信噪比随红移的变化。图中显示了总AGN群体（实线）和低于CDIM 5 \(\sigma\) 直接探测极限的群体（虚线）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3 : Signal-to-noise on \(S_{NeV}\) and \(b_{NeV}\) using redshift-space distortions as described in Appendix A, for a CDIM-like survey cross-correlating galaxies and [Ne v ] \(\lambda 3426\) . Both total (solid lines) and sub-5 \(\sigma\) detection threshold contributions (dotted lines) are shown.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：针对CDIM类巡天对星系和[Ne v ] \(\lambda 3426\) 进行互相关时，使用附录A所述的红移空间畸变得到的 \(S_{NeV}\) 和 \(b_{NeV}\) 的信噪比。图中显示了总贡献（实线）和低于5 \(\sigma\) 探测阈值的贡献（虚线）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4 : Cumulative fraction of the total [Ne v ] mean intensity \(S_{NeV}\) contributed by AGN below a given bolometric luminosity, \(L_{cut}\) , for a CDIM-like survey targeting [Ne v ] \(\lambda 3426\) . The 5 \(\sigma\) CDIM direct detection thresholds at \(z=2\) and \(z=3\) are marked with vertical lines, both of which correspond to being above approximately 10% of the cumulative signal.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：针对CDIM类巡天对[Ne v ] \(\lambda 3426\) 进行探测时，低于给定热光度 \(L_{cut}\) 的AGN对总[Ne v ]平均强度 \(S_{NeV}\) 的累积贡献比例。 \(z=2\) 和 \(z=3\) 处的5 \(\sigma\) CDIM直接探测阈值用垂直线标出，两者均对应高于累积信号的约10%。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 引力束缚的暗物质（DM）过密度（即晕）的形成是粒子暗物质理论的一个普遍预测。我们展示了近期由詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）观测的28个四重像强透镜系统中的晕性质测量结果，并利用这些观测来约束暗物质的自由流长λ_FS，该量取决于暗物质粒子质量和形成机制。我们改进了之前的透镜分析，通过同时重建延展的透镜弧、像位置和相对放大率，增强了对晕扰动的敏感性。我们的分析排除了在尺度上偏离冷暗物质（CDM）预测的情况，对于由宇宙学N体模拟和半解析模型预测的子晕丰度，分别排除了大于10^7.2 M_⊙和10^7.4 M_⊙的尺度。这些界限对应于上限λ_FS < 6.0 kpc和λ_FS < 7.0 kpc，以及自旋1/2热遗迹暗物质粒子质量的下限m_therm > 7.4 keV和m_therm > 6.5 keV。相反，假设自由流长可忽略（如CDM所预测），我们测量了椭圆星系周围子晕的投影质量，在95%置信水平下为1.7_{-1.2}^{+2.6} × 10^7 M_⊙ kpc^{-2}。这些推断证实了CDM范式的关键预测。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，这些推断证实了冷暗物质范式的关键预测，同时对温暗物质等替代模型给出了严格的观测限制。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: The joint posterior probability distribution for the normalization of the projected subhalo mass function ( \(\Sigma_{{sub}}\) , Equation 7 ) and half-mode mass ( \(m_{{hm}}\) , Equation 2 ), jointly inferred from 28 lenses. The upper x-axis on the marginal distribution for \(m_{{hm}}\) shows the corresponding spin-1/2 thermal relic particle mass. We show three different priors on \(\Sigma_{{sub}}\) . One-side \(95\%\) exclusion limits, and 10:1 Bayes factor constraints taken with respect to the peak of the marginal distribution, are summarized in Table 1 . Contours show \(68\%\) and \(95\%\) confidence regions.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：从28个透镜联合推断的投影子晕质量函数归一化（\(\Sigma_{{sub}}\)，方程7）和半模质量（\(m_{{hm}}\)，方程2）的联合后验概率分布。\(m_{{hm}}\)边缘分布的上x轴显示了相应的自旋1/2热遗迹粒子质量。我们展示了\(\Sigma_{{sub}}\)的三种不同先验。单侧95%排除限和相对于边缘分布峰值的10:1贝叶斯因子约束总结在表1中。等高线显示68%和95%置信区域。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Lower bounds on the thermal relic particle mass \(m_{{therm}}\) derived from constraints on the half-mode mass \(m_{{hm}}\) under different priors on \(\log_{10}\Sigma_{{sub}}/{kpc}^{-2}\) . We quote both the one-sided \(95\%\) exclusion limits, and the value of \(m_{{mtherm}}\) disfavored at 10:1 odds (or a 10:1 Bayes factor).
figures.caption_zh: 表1：在不同\(\log_{10}\Sigma_{{sub}}/{kpc}^{-2}\)先验下，从半模质量\(m_{{hm}}\)约束导出的热遗迹粒子质量\(m_{{therm}}\)的下限。我们同时引用了单侧95%排除限，以及在10:1几率（或10:1贝叶斯因子）下被排除的\(m_{{mtherm}}\)值。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: The posterior distribution of \(\Sigma_{{sub}}\) obtained from taking the CDM limit through a prior on the half-mode mass \(\pi\left(\log_{10}m_{{hm}}/{M}_{\odot}\right)=\mathcal{N}\left(4.0,0.5\right)\) . The color scheme is the same as the left panel of Figure 1 . Vertical dashed lines represent \(95\%\) confidence intervals. Predictions from the semi-analytic model \(\tt{galacticus}\) and \(N\) -body simulations are marked with vertical lines. The upper x-axis shows the corresponding projected mass density in subhalos with infall masses in the range \(10^{6}<m/M_{\odot}<10^{10.7}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图2：通过半模质量先验\(\pi\left(\log_{10}m_{{hm}}/{M}_{\odot}\right)=\mathcal{N}\left(4.0,0.5\right)\)取CDM极限得到的\(\Sigma_{{sub}}\)后验分布。颜色方案与图1左面板相同。垂直虚线表示95%置信区间。来自半解析模型\(\tt{galacticus}\)和N体模拟的预测用垂直线标记。上x轴显示了在落入质量范围\(10^{6}<m/M_{\odot}<10^{10.7}\)内的子晕对应的投影质量密度。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 在本系列论文中，我们提出了强透镜（SL）星系团中成员星系的动力学模型，以独立探究SL模型与宇宙学模拟之间在星系团子暗晕总质量属性方面持续存在的差异。在这项工作中，我们将研究重点放在Abell 2744（$z=0.309$）和MACS J0416.1-2403（$z=0.397$）内的早型星系上。我们利用了深度MUSE光谱数据，并辅以HFF测光数据。我们使用基于光谱拟合的流程对109个成员星系的视线方向速度弥散度廓线进行了运动学测量。我们假设星系具有dPIE总质量密度分布和Jaffe恒星质量密度分布进行建模。根据模型，我们推断出样本中星系的中心恒星速度弥散度$σ_0$和截断半径$r_t$的值。我们发现，所有成员星系的$σ_0$都能被精确恢复，而对于样本中具有足够扩展径向运动学覆盖范围的一部分星系，$r_t$可以被可靠测量。我们的动力学模型预测的视线方向速度弥散度廓线比SL模型推断的廓线更好地拟合了测量值。然后，我们利用从动力学模型获得的$σ_0$测量值来校准两个星系团中成员星系的Faber-Jackson标度关系。当我们将我们的关系与先前运动学和SL工作中获得的关系进行比较时，我们发现归一化系数系统性更高，而斜率和弥散值则兼容。我们得出结论，我们对$σ_0$和$r_t$的动力学测量值以及校准后的标度关系比以往未考虑PSF效应而有偏的运动学估计更稳健，因此应作为改进的初始预设用于未来的SL模型。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，本研究的结论是：对$σ_0$和$r_t$的动力学测量值以及校准后的标度关系比以往未考虑PSF效应而有偏的运动学估计更稳健，因此应作为改进的初始预设用于未来的强透镜模型。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Spectrum of the cluster galaxy 80726 in M0416, extracted from a circular aperture with radius \(r=0.5^{\prime\prime}\) centered on the galaxy luminosity center. The black line shows the measured spectrum, while the red line shows the fitted spectrum, obtained with the pPXF pipeline, from rest-frame \(3700\,${\SIUnitSymbolAngstrom}$\) to \(5100\,${\SIUnitSymbolAngstrom}$\) . On the bottom, the residuals between the two spectra are shown as green dots. The gray bands highlight masked regions. On the top, the values of the extracted kinematic parameters are listed: the velocity dispersion \(\sigma\) and the peculiar velocity \(v\) , in \({km\,s^{-1}}\) , with their corresponding uncertainties, and the average signal-to-noise ratio ¡S/N¿.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：M0416中星系团成员星系80726的光谱，从以星系光度中心为中心、半径为\(r=0.5^{\prime\prime}\)的圆形孔径中提取。黑线显示测量光谱，红线显示使用pPXF流程从静止帧\(3700\,${\SIUnitSymbolAngstrom}$\)到\(5100\,${\SIUnitSymbolAngstrom}$\)获得的拟合光谱。底部，两个光谱之间的残差以绿点显示。灰色带突出显示被遮蔽的区域。顶部列出了提取的运动学参数值：速度弥散度\(\sigma\)和本动速度\(v\)，单位为\({km\,s^{-1}}\)，及其相应不确定度，以及平均信噪比¡S/N¿。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: MUSE cube cutout of the galaxy 80726 in the cluster of galaxies M0416. The annuli of \(0.5^{\prime\prime}\) width and increasing radial size, within which the LOS velocity dispersion profile was measured, are shown.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：M0416星系团中星系80726的MUSE数据立方体切片。显示了宽度为\(0.5^{\prime\prime}\)且径向尺寸递增的环带，在这些环带内测量了视线方向速度弥散度廓线。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Measured LOS velocity dispersion profile of galaxy 80726 as a function of the radial distance from the center, in both arcsec (bottom) and kpc (top). The red lines along the horizontal axis show the uncertainty on the measurement position due to each annulus width, as shown in Fig. 2 , while the ones along the vertical axis represent the uncertainty on each measured \(\sigma_{\text{LOS}}\) , obtained from the pPXF pipeline.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：星系80726的测量视线方向速度弥散度廓线，作为距中心径向距离的函数，单位分别为角秒（底部）和千秒差距（顶部）。沿水平轴的红线显示了由于每个环带宽度（如图2所示）导致的测量位置不确定度，而沿垂直轴的红线表示从pPXF流程获得的每个测量\(\sigma_{\text{LOS}}\)的不确定度。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Corner plot obtained from the inference procedure on the cluster galaxy 83064 in M0416. The posterior probability distributions for \(\sigma_{0}\) and \(r_{t}\) and their correlation are shown. The median values and 16th and 84th percentiles are reported at the top and highlighted with blue and green lines.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：从M0416中星系团成员星系83064的推断过程获得的角点图。显示了\(\sigma_{0}\)和\(r_{t}\)的后验概率分布及其相关性。中位值以及第16和第84百分位数在顶部报告，并用蓝色和绿色线突出显示。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Comparison between measured and model-predicted velocity dispersion profiles. In black, we show the profile obtained from the kinematic measurements (red data points) of the cluster member 83064 in M0416. As orange solid lines, we plot 100 profiles obtained with the dynamical model by sampling the posterior distributions of the free parameters, drawn from the MCMC optimization and shown in Fig. 4 . The distance from the galactic center is reported in arcsecs (bottom) and kpc (top).
figures.caption_zh: 图5：测量与模型预测的速度弥散度廓线之间的比较。黑色显示从M0416中星系团成员83064的运动学测量（红色数据点）获得的廓线。橙色实线绘制了通过从MCMC优化（如图4所示）得到的自由参数后验分布采样而获得的100条动力学模型廓线。距星系中心的距离以角秒（底部）和千秒差距（顶部）报告。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Corner plots of the central stellar velocity dispersion, \(\sigma_{0}\) , and truncation radius, \(r_{t}\) , for two cluster members (38729 on the left and 34423 on the right) in A2744, obtained from the inference procedure. The posterior probability distributions of \(\sigma_{0}\) and \(r_{t}\) and their correlations are shown. The median values and percentiles are highlighted as in Fig. 4 . The \(r_{t}\) posterior probability distributions for these galaxies are classified as ‘Flat’ and ‘Tailed’, respectively. The \(\sigma_{0}\) posterior distribution is close to a Gaussian distribution for both galaxies.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：从推断过程获得的A2744中两个星系团成员（左侧为38729，右侧为34423）的中心恒星速度弥散度\(\sigma_{0}\)和截断半径\(r_{t}\)的角点图。显示了\(\sigma_{0}\)和\(r_{t}\)的后验概率分布及其相关性。中位值和百分位数如图4所示突出显示。这些星系的\(r_{t}\)后验概率分布分别被分类为“平坦”和“有尾”。两个星系的\(\sigma_{0}\)后验分布都接近高斯分布。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Comparison between the measured, SL, and dynamically modeled velocity dispersion profiles for a M0416 cluster member (ID: 83064). In black, we plot the measured kinematic profile. In orange, we show 100 profiles obtained with the dPIE-J dynamical model. In green and blue, we plot 100 profiles obtained from the calibrated and optimized F-J scaling relations from B+21 and B+23b , respectively. The uncertainties and the distance are defined as in Fig. 3 .
figures.caption_zh: 图7：M0416星系团成员（ID: 83064）的测量、SL和动力学建模的速度弥散度廓线比较。黑色绘制了测量的运动学廓线。橙色显示了使用dPIE-J动力学模型获得的100条廓线。绿色和蓝色分别绘制了根据B+21和B+23b校准和优化的F-J标度关系获得的100条廓线。不确定度和距离的定义如图3所示。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Comparison of the parameters of the F-J scaling relation obtained from the dynamical models, the SL models optimizations, and previous literature kinematic measurements, for the clusters of galaxies A2744 and M0416. 2 2 2 We report the slope, \(\alpha\) , normalization, \(\sigma_{r}\) , and scatter, \(\Delta\sigma_{r}\) , obtained from the Kinematic measurements performed in B+23a and B+21 , reported as ‘Kin’; Strong lensing measurements form B+23a and B+23b , listed as ‘SL’; and our dynamical model measurements, labeled as ‘Dynamical’. The ‘FS’ and ‘RS’ labels indicate that the full and restricted samples of galaxies from the listed papers were used to calibrate the scaling relations, respectively. The ‘RS’ sample, further restricted to the galaxies with more than two kinematic measurements, is labeled as ‘2p’.
figures.caption_zh: 表1：对于星系团A2744和M0416，从动力学模型、SL模型优化以及先前文献运动学测量获得的F-J标度关系参数比较。我们报告了斜率\(\alpha\)、归一化系数\(\sigma_{r}\)和弥散\(\Delta\sigma_{r}\)，这些参数分别来自B+23a和B+21中进行的运动学测量（标记为“Kin”）、B+23a和B+23b的强透镜测量（列为“SL”），以及我们的动力学模型测量（标记为“Dynamical”）。“FS”和“RS”标签分别表示使用了所列论文中的完整星系样本和受限星系样本来校准标度关系。进一步限制为具有多于两个运动学测量值的星系样本“RS”被标记为“2p”。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 利用JWST/NIRISS无缝光谱数据，我们对前景星系团Abell 2744引力透镜的79个星系（红移$1.1 < z < 2.3$）进行了空间分辨的巴尔默减缩测量。通过按恒星质量和红移分箱叠加$\mathrm{H}α$和$\mathrm{H}β$发射线图，我们推导了星云尘埃消光以及尘埃校正后的恒星形成率（SFR）的径向轮廓。我们初步发现，朝向$\mathrm{H}α$的尘埃消光（$\rm A(\mathrm{H}α)$）的径向梯度随红移和恒星质量而变化。在较低红移（$z = 1.10$–$1.53$）处，低质量星系（$\rm 7.0<\log(M_*/M_\odot)\leq8.5$）表现出比高质量星系（$\rm 9.5<\log(M_*/M_\odot)\leq11.0$）更陡的$\rm A(Hα)$梯度，而后者在更大的星系半径范围内仍可探测到尘埃消光。较高红移（$z = 1.76$–$2.29$）的星系显示出较低的消光水平。在固定星系半径处，低红移分箱中的星系通常比高红移星系具有更高的尘埃消光，这与尘埃含量随宇宙时间增加而增加的趋势一致。低红移大质量星系中经尘埃校正的SFR轮廓在空间上比高红移星系更延展，这与$z\lesssim1.5$时由内而外的盘状增长一致。这些结果表明，尘埃消光特性在恒星质量和红移区间可能存在差异，并展示了引力透镜技术以亚千秒差距分辨率探测暗弱星系内部结构的能力。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的总结：尘埃消光特性在恒星质量和红移区间存在差异，引力透镜技术为研究暗弱星系内部亚千秒差距尺度的结构提供了有力手段。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: SFR and stellar mass ( \(M_{\ast}\) ) for our galaxy samples, which are corrected for lensing magnification using the mass model of Bergamini2023 . Blue and red dots correspond to the galaxies for the \(1.10\leq z\leq 1.53\) and \(1.76\leq z\leq 2.29\) samples, respectively. The stellar mass ranges adopted for stacking are denoted by the grey shaded regions and medians for each bin are indicated by dark squares. The thick solid lines represent SFMS from whitaker2014constraining .

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Example JWST/NIRISS data products for a galaxy (ID 02969) in the Abell 2744 field. The top row shows the RGB thumbnail, F115W thumbnail and emission-line maps, with observed wavelengths labeled. Each image spans \(3^{\prime\prime}\times 3^{\prime\prime}\) ( \(\sim\) 25 kpc at \(z=1.36\) ) at \(0\farcs 03\) per pixel. The bottom left panel shows the log p(z) plot, the unnormalized logarithm of the posterior redshift probability density which is used to assess the relative likelihood of different redshift solutions, showing a sharp peak at \(z=1.36\) with a narrow redshift posterior uncertainty, indicating a well-constrained redshift solution. The bottom right panel shows the 1D NIRISS grism spectra covered in F115W, F150W and F200W filters.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：Abell 2744场中一个星系（ID 02969）的JWST/NIRISS数据产品示例。顶行显示RGB缩略图、F115W缩略图和发射线图，观测波长已标注。每张图像大小为\(3^{\prime\prime}\times 3^{\prime\prime}\)（在\(z=1.36\)处约为25 kpc），像素分辨率为\(0\farcs 03\)。左下方面板显示log p(z)图，即后验红移概率密度的未归一化对数，用于评估不同红移解的相对似然，在\(z=1.36\)处呈现尖锐峰值且后验红移不确定性窄，表明红移解约束良好。右下方面板显示F115W、F150W和F200W滤光片覆盖的1D NIRISS光栅光谱。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Radial profiles of the Balmer decrement and the dust attenuation towards H \(\alpha\) emission. The blue and red lines represent galaxies at redshifts of \(1.10\leq z\leq 1.53\) and \(1.76\leq z\leq 2.29\) respectively. The top panels show the H \(\alpha\) /H \(\beta\) ratios with a dashed line at 2.86 and the bottom row shows dust attenuation towards H \(\alpha\) using the calzetti2000dust dust extinction law. In the bottom row, the light blue dashed line with error envelopes shows result of \(z\sim 1.4\) from nelson2016spatially .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：巴尔默减缩和朝向H \(\alpha\)发射的尘埃消光的径向轮廓。蓝色和红色线分别代表红移\(1.10\leq z\leq 1.53\)和\(1.76\leq z\leq 2.29\)的星系。上面板显示H \(\alpha\) /H \(\beta\)比值，虚线位于2.86；下面板使用calzetti2000dust尘埃消光律显示朝向H \(\alpha\)的尘埃消光。下面板中，带误差包的浅蓝色虚线显示来自nelson2016spatially的\(z\sim 1.4\)结果。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Dust-corrected SFR radial profiles. The radial distribution of SFR measured directly by H \(\alpha\) is shown in dashed lines, and the blue and red solid lines represent SFR profiles corrected using the radial Balmer decrement curves for the two redshift bins, respectively. The light blue dashed lines show results of \(z\sim 1.4\) from nelson2016spatially . The differences between dashed and solid lines imply the detection of previously dust-obscured star-forming regions.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：尘埃校正后的SFR径向轮廓。由H \(\alpha\)直接测量的SFR径向分布以虚线显示，蓝色和红色实线分别代表使用两个红移分箱的径向巴尔默减缩曲线校正后的SFR轮廓。浅蓝色虚线显示来自nelson2016spatially的\(z\sim 1.4\)结果。虚线与实线之间的差异暗示探测到了先前被尘埃遮蔽的恒星形成区域。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个包含多相星际介质（ISM）中晶粒尺寸演化的星系演化模型，以研究红移z ≥ 5星系中的尘埃消光。我们的基准设置假设低尘埃产率y_d = 10^{-4} M_⊙和恒星尘埃的小特征尺寸a_0 = 0.01 μm，其动机是致密ISM环境中反向激波对尘埃的高效破坏。我们的模型表明，即使尘埃产率如此之低，质量M_* > 10^9 M_⊙的大质量星系在z ~ 7时仍能达到高尘埃-恒星质量比M_d/M_* ~ 10^{-2}，这是因为超新星提供的小晶粒在ISM中有效地充当了金属吸积的种子。由于尘埃生长显著滞后于恒星形成，半恒星形成率半径之外的区域仍然相对缺乏尘埃，使得相当一部分紫外光子能够逃逸而不受强烈消光。我们进一步发现，当ISM由冷致密气体主导但仍包含适度的暖成分时，尘埃生长最为高效，因为前者促进金属吸积，而后者通过碎裂提供额外的小晶粒，从而进一步增强后续的晶粒生长。特别是，当冷致密气体分数约为90%时，我们的模型预测与z ~ 7富尘埃星系推断的尘埃-恒星质量比以及z ≳ 10蓝星系的上限大致一致。自洽地，该模型成功再现了在z = 7和z = 12观测到的紫外光度函数。总体而言，这项研究表明，对多相ISM中晶粒生长的物理自洽处理，对于将高红移星系的尘埃含量与其在宇宙黎明时期的辐射特性联系起来至关重要。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的总结：在宇宙黎明时期，对多相ISM中尘埃生长的物理自洽处理，是连接高红移星系尘埃含量与辐射特性的关键。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2 : Left panels show the dust grain size distributions, and right panels show the corresponding extinction curves derived from our fiducial model. The plotted size distribution is expressed as \(a^{4}n(a)/n_{H}\) , which represents the dust mass density per hydrogen nucleus. Black, brown, cyan, purple, orange, and blue curves correspond to \(z=19,14,12,10,7,\) and \(5\) , respectively. Panels (a) and (b) present the results at \(R=100~{pc}\) , while panels (c) and (d) show those at \(R=1000~{pc}\) . Panels (e) and (f) display the grain size distributions and extinction curves averaged over the galactic disk, weighted by the dust surface mass density. For comparison, the Milky Way grain size distribution, \(n(a)\propto a^{-3.3}\) (Jones et al. , 1996 ) , is shown by the black dotted lines in panels (a), (c), and (e). The Milky Way extinction curve with \(R_{V}=3.1\) (Pei, 1992 ) is shown by gray circles in panels (b), (d), and (f).
figures.caption_zh: 图2：左图显示尘埃晶粒尺寸分布，右图显示由我们的基准模型得出的相应消光曲线。绘制的尺寸分布表示为a^{4}n(a)/n_{H}，代表每个氢核的尘埃质量密度。黑色、棕色、青色、紫色、橙色和蓝色曲线分别对应z=19、14、12、10、7和5。图(a)和(b)展示了R=100 pc处的结果，而图(c)和(d)展示了R=1000 pc处的结果。图(e)和(f)显示了以尘埃面质量密度加权的星系盘平均晶粒尺寸分布和消光曲线。作为比较，银河系晶粒尺寸分布n(a)\propto a^{-3.3}（Jones et al.，1996）在图(a)、(c)和(e)中以黑色虚线显示。具有R_{V}=3.1的银河系消光曲线（Pei，1992）在图(b)、(d)和(f)中以灰色圆圈显示。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3 : Same as Figures 2 e and 2 f, but for models with different parameter sets from the fiducial case. The left and right panels show the grain size distributions and extinction curves averaged over the galactic disk, weighted by the dust surface mass density. Panels (a) and (b) present the results for the model with \(f_{c}^{M}=0.5\) , panels (c) and (d) for \(y_{d}=10^{-2}~{M_{\odot}}\) , and panels (e) and (f) for \(a_{0}=0.1~\mu\) m. For comparison, the results of the fiducial model are shown by dotted lines in all panels.

figures.caption_en: Figure 4 : Relation between dust and stellar masses obtained from our calculations for 21 dark matter halos. The left, middle, and right panels show the results at \(z=12\) , 9, and 7, respectively. In the upper row, models with different CMG mass fractions are compared: \(f_{c}^{M}=1\) (blue), \(0.9\) (orange), \(0.5\) (purple), and \(0.1\) (cyan). In the lower row, models with different SN dust properties are compared: \((\log(y_{d}/{M_{\odot}}),\,\log(a_{0}/\mu{m}))=(-2,\,-2)\) (blue), \((-4,\,-2)\) (orange), \((-6,\,-2)\) (purple), and \((-4,\,-1)\) (cyan). In both the upper and lower panels, the orange lines represent the fiducial case in Table 2 . For comparison, observational data for galaxies at the corresponding redshift ranges are also shown. White squares in the right panels represent galaxies at \(6 Hashimoto et al. ( 2019 ); Reuter et al. ( 2020 ); Bakx et al. ( 2021 ); Sommovigo et al. ( 2022 ); Umehata et al. ( 2025 ) . The yellow star in the middle panels represents the observational data of MACS0416_Y1 at \(z=8.31\) , currently the highest redshift galaxy with a dust mass measurement (Bakx et al. , 2025 ) . In the left and middle panels, black downward arrows indicate upper limits on the dust masses of individual galaxies at \(8 10\) , inferred by Algera et al. ( 2023 ); Bakx et al. ( 2026 ) . Brown downward arrows correspond to upper limits on the dust masses inferred from the stacking analysis for galaxies at \(z 9.5\) (Bakx et al. , 2026 ) . Here, we include only spectroscopically confirmed galaxies from the literature. Accordingly, we exclude two photometrically identified galaxies, SPT-0615 ( \(z_{ph}=9.63\) ) and COS-z12-1 ( \(z_{ph}=12.25\) ), which were reported to have extremely low dust-to-stellar mass ratios of \(M_{d}/M_{\ast} (Bakx et al. , 2026 ) .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：从我们对21个暗物质晕的计算中得到的尘埃质量与恒星质量之间的关系。左、中、右图分别显示z=12、9和7时的结果。上行比较了不同CMG质量分数的模型：f_{c}^{M}=1（蓝色）、0.9（橙色）、0.5（紫色）和0.1（青色）。下行比较了不同超新星尘埃特性的模型：(\log(y_{d}/{M_{\odot}}),\,\log(a_{0}/\mu{m}))=(-2,\,-2)（蓝色）、(-4,\,-2)（橙色）、(-6,\,-2)（紫色）和(-4,\,-1)（青色）。在上行和下行图中，橙色线代表表2中的基准情况。作为比较，还显示了相应红移范围内星系的观测数据。右图中的白色方块代表z<7的星系（Hashimoto et al.，2019；Reuter et al.，2020；Bakx et al.，2021；Sommovigo et al.，2022；Umehata et al.，2025）。中图中的黄色星代表z=8.31处MACS0416_Y1的观测数据，这是目前红移最高的有尘埃质量测量的星系（Bakx et al.，2025）。在左图和中间图中，黑色向下箭头表示8<z<10处单个星系尘埃质量的上限，由Algera等人（2023）和Bakx等人（2026）推断。棕色向下箭头对应于z>9.5处星系堆叠分析推断的尘埃质量上限（Bakx et al.，2026）。这里，我们只包含文献中经光谱证认的星系。因此，我们排除了两个测光证认的星系SPT-0615（z_{ph}=9.63）和COS-z12-1（z_{ph}=12.25），它们被报道具有极低的尘埃-恒星质量比M_{d}/M_{\ast}（Bakx et al.，2026）。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 红移z>2的星系原星团是高密度区域，在这些区域中，冷气体的可用性和增强的星系相互作用率会触发剧烈的、通常被尘埃遮蔽的恒星形成。这些机制也被预期会促进超大质量黑洞的增长，但这一效应仍不清楚，这主要是由于先前研究中异质的星系选择和活动星系核识别方法所致。我们通过测量原星团中以及均匀选择的控制场样本中尘埃星暴星系中X射线活动星系核的出现率，定量评估了原星团环境对超大质量黑洞增长的影响，并研究了导致任何差异的物理机制。我们考虑了在2<z<4.5的七个原星团的亚毫米/毫米连续谱中由ALMA探测到的尘埃星暴星系，并从COSMOS巡天中构建了一个选择匹配的控制样本。我们统计比较了通过均匀光谱能量分布拟合获得的X射线活动星系核出现率和宿主星系物理性质。我们发现原星团中X射线活动星系核的比例显著增强了约2.7倍（泊松显著性p=3e-4）。在两个红移区间内发现了相似的值：z=2-3时约2.7倍（p=0.003），z=3-4.5时约2.6倍（p=0.03）。原星团和场尘埃星暴星系样本在恒星质量、恒星形成率和尘埃质量上匹配良好，排除了选择效应或系统性地更高的宿主质量作为驱动因素。我们的结果提供了定量证据，表明密集的原星团环境增强了尘埃星暴星系中的活动星系核出现率和超大质量黑洞增长，其程度超出了仅由宿主星系性质所能预测的范围，这很可能是通过增加气体可用性和相互作用驱动的物质吸积实现的。这项工作是在宇宙时间尺度上均匀评估环境对超大质量黑洞增长影响的第一步。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，密集星系原星团环境显著增强了尘埃星暴星系中的活动星系核活动，推动了超大质量黑洞的增长，这一效应独立于宿主星系本身的性质，很可能通过增加气体可用性和相互作用驱动的物质吸积实现。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 弱引力透镜质量成图提供了物质分布的直接探测手段。由于巡天边界和空间变化的噪声，从掩蔽的剪切星表准确重建质量图仍然具有挑战性。在AKRA 2.0中，我们通过显式构造并求逆法方程矩阵 $\bf{H} \equiv \mathbf{A}^\mathrm{T}\mathbf{N}^{-1} \mathbf{A}$ 来解决弯曲天空上的掩膜问题，这需要采用分尺度策略，独立重建不同角尺度以达到高分辨率。在此，我们提出AKRA 3.0，其中 $\mathbf{H}$ 被视为线性算子，法方程通过共轭梯度（CG）法求解。这一重新表述将内存需求从 $O(N^2)$ 降低到 $O(N)$，并将求逆成本从 $O(N^3)$ 降低到 $O(N_{\rm iter}N^{3/2})$，其中 $N \sim \ell_{\rm{max}}^2$ 用于全天（基于SHT）操作。这些优化使得高分辨率全天重建对于Stage~III和Stage~IV巡天变得可行。将AKRA 3.0应用于DES Y3 \texttt{METACALIBRATION} 星表，我们在HEALPix $N_{\rm{nside}}= 2048$ 下生成了该数据集迄今为止最高分辨率的会聚图，且未施加任何先验假设。我们直接从重建图中提取会聚功率谱，并证明可以从重建图中直接获得无偏的两点测量。重建的E模会聚图将作为数据产品公开发布，以支持未来对非高斯统计、高阶矩以及与外部数据集的交叉关联的研究。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：AKRA 3.0实现了高效、高分辨率、无先验的弱引力透镜质量重构，重构的E模会聚图将作为数据产品公开，支持非高斯统计、高阶矩和交叉关联等研究。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Overview of the AKRA 3.0 matrix-free mass-mapping workflow. Input shear catalogs and survey metadata (column 1) are pixelized into spin-weighted spherical-harmonic data vectors. The operator \(\boldsymbol{\mathcal{A}}\) and its adjoint \(\boldsymbol{\mathcal{A}}^{{T}}\) (column 2) are never stored as dense matrices but applied implicitly via paired spherical harmonic transforms and masking operations. A (preconditioned) conjugate-gradient solver (column 3) iterates the normal equations \(\boldsymbol{\mathcal{H}}\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}=\boldsymbol{b}\) to convergence. The output (column 4) is an unbiased, prior-free maximum-likelihood convergence map, with \(\kappa_{B}\) serving as a systematics diagnostic. The computational cost of the direct approach (AKRA 2.0) is contrasted with the AKRA 3.0 in Fig. 2 , which demonstrates a memory reduction by a factor of \({\sim}10^{6}\) at \(N_{{side}}=2048\) alongside the corresponding speed benchmarks.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：AKRA 3.0无矩阵质量成图工作流程概览。输入剪切星表和巡天元数据（第1列）被像素化为自旋加权球谐函数数据向量。算子 \(\boldsymbol{\mathcal{A}}\) 及其伴随算子 \(\boldsymbol{\mathcal{A}}^{{T}}\)（第2列）从不作为稠密矩阵存储，而是通过配对的球谐变换和掩膜操作隐式应用。（预处理）共轭梯度求解器（第3列）迭代法方程 \(\boldsymbol{\mathcal{H}}\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}=\boldsymbol{b}\) 直至收敛。输出（第4列）是一个无偏、无先验的最大似然会聚图，其中 \(\kappa_{B}\) 作为系统学诊断。直接方法（AKRA 2.0）的计算成本与AKRA 3.0在图2中进行对比，该图展示了在 \(N_{{side}}=2048\) 时内存减少了约 \({\sim}10^{6}\) 倍以及相应的速度基准。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Computational comparison of three methods for solving the normal equations. Top: Conceptual diagram illustrating how the normal equations are solved. The approaches differ in memory and speed based on the object held in memory and the operation that dominates runtime: the full dense \(N\times N\) matrix (direct), many small dense blocks processed sequentially (scale-split), or a few length- \(N\) vectors paired with a reused operator (matrix-free), where \(N=(\ell_{{max}}+1)^{2}\) . Bottom: Scaling of peak memory and wall-clock time versus resolution. By reducing the memory footprint by \({\sim}4\times 10^{6}\) at \(N_{side}=2048\) and \({\sim}2\times 10^{7}\) at \(N_{side}=4096\) , AKRA 3.0 allows the full reconstruction to be run on a single compute node. Specific computational requirements can be estimated using the code available on GitHub .
figures.caption_zh: 图2：三种求解法方程方法的计算比较。上：概念图说明法方程如何求解。这些方法在内存和速度上的差异取决于内存中保存的对象以及主导运行时间的操作：完整的稠密 \(N\times N\) 矩阵（直接法）、许多按顺序处理的小型稠密块（分尺度法）、或几个长度为 \(N\) 的向量与一个重复使用的算子配对（无矩阵法），其中 \(N=(\ell_{{max}}+1)^{2}\)。下：峰值内存和挂钟时间随分辨率的变化。通过在 \(N_{side}=2048\) 时减少约 \({\sim}4\times 10^{6}\) 倍、在 \(N_{side}=4096\) 时减少约 \({\sim}2\times 10^{7}\) 倍的内存占用，AKRA 3.0允许在单个计算节点上运行完整重建。具体计算需求可使用GitHub上提供的代码进行估算。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Summary of the DES Y3 shear samples analyzed with AKRA 3.0. For each sample we list the photometric redshift range, the HEALPix resolution \(N_{side}\) and corresponding pixel area \(A_{pix}\) used in the reconstruction, the mean METACALIBRATION shear response \(\langle R\rangle\) , the residual multiplicative shear-calibration bias \(m\) applied as a power-spectrum correction ( \(C_{\ell}^{\kappa\kappa}\to C_{\ell}^{\kappa\kappa}/(1+m)^{2}\) ), the sample-averaged effective source density \(\bar{n}_{eff}\) , the mean effective galaxy count per pixel \(\bar{N}_{eff}=\bar{n}_{eff}\,A_{pix}\) , the adopted mask threshold \(n_{th}\) and its per-pixel equivalent \(N_{th}=n_{th}\,A_{pix}\) , and the fractional information loss incurred by the mask cut. The two random-split samples are constructed from a galaxy-level random partition of the full shear catalog into two disjoint halves.
figures.caption_zh: 表1：使用AKRA 3.0分析的DES Y3剪切样本总结。对于每个样本，我们列出了光致红移范围、重建中使用的HEALPix分辨率 \(N_{side}\) 及对应的像素面积 \(A_{pix}\)、平均METACALIBRATION剪切响应 \(\langle R\rangle\)、作为功率谱校正应用的残余乘性剪切校准偏差 \(m\)（ \(C_{\ell}^{\kappa\kappa}\to C_{\ell}^{\kappa\kappa}/(1+m)^{2}\) ）、样本平均有效源密度 \(\bar{n}_{eff}\)、每个像素的平均有效星系计数 \(\bar{N}_{eff}=\bar{n}_{eff}\,A_{pix}\)、采用的掩膜阈值 \(n_{th}\) 及其每像素等效值 \(N_{th}=n_{th}\,A_{pix}\)，以及由掩膜切割引起的信息损失分数。两个随机分割样本是通过将完整剪切星表在星系层面随机划分为两个不相交的半部分而构建的。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Reconstructed convergence map of the DES Y3 weak-lensing data obtained with AKRA 3.0. Left: Full DES Y3 footprint, shown in equatorial coordinates. Right: Three \(10^{\circ}\times 10^{\circ}\) zoom-in regions along RA \(=30^{\circ}\) , at Dec \(=-5^{\circ}\) (R1, top), \(-30^{\circ}\) (R2, middle), and \(-55^{\circ}\) (R3, bottom). The map is produced on a HEALPix grid with \(N_{side}=2048\) (pixel scale \(\sim\) 1.72 arcmin) up to \(\ell_{max}=4096\) , and smoothed with a \(6^{\prime}\) Gaussian kernel for visualization. This represents the highest-resolution, prior-free convergence map of the DES Y3 footprint produced to date.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：使用AKRA 3.0获得的DES Y3弱透镜数据重建的会聚图。左：完整的DES Y3覆盖区域，以赤道坐标显示。右：沿赤经 \(=30^{\circ}\)、赤纬 \(=-5^{\circ}\)（R1，上）、\(-30^{\circ}\)（R2，中）和 \(-55^{\circ}\)（R3，下）的三个 \(10^{\circ}\times 10^{\circ}\) 放大区域。该图在HEALPix网格上生成，分辨率为 \(N_{side}=2048\)（像素尺度约1.72角分），最大 \(\ell_{max}=4096\)，并使用 \(6^{\prime}\) 高斯核进行平滑以便可视化。这是迄今为止生成的DES Y3覆盖区域最高分辨率、无先验的会聚图。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Non-tomographic power spectra of the DES Y3 convergence map reconstructed by AKRA 3.0 (red) and KS (blue), compared with the theoretical \(\Lambda\) CDM prediction at the fiducial Planck 2018 cosmology (gray dashed curve), shown for reference rather than as a best-fit model. Left: cross-power spectrum \(C_{\ell}^{\kappa_{A}\kappa_{B}}\) between two independent convergence maps reconstructed from disjoint, randomly split sub-samples of the DES Y3 source catalog. Because the shape-noise realizations of the two sub-samples are statistically independent, the cross-spectrum is free of shape-noise bias at; error bars are estimated from 10 paired noise realizations. Right: auto-power spectrum \(C_{\ell}^{\kappa\kappa}\) of the map from the full sample. The solid lines is the raw spectrum (signal plus shape noise) and the points show the spectrum after subtracting the estimated shape-noise bias \(N_{\ell}\) ; error bars are from 50 realizations. Noise realizations are built by shuffling the observed shear among the unmasked pixels.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：由AKRA 3.0（红色）和KS（蓝色）重建的DES Y3会聚图的非层析功率谱，与基准Planck 2018宇宙学下的理论 \(\Lambda\) CDM预测（灰色虚线曲线）进行比较，该预测作为参考而非最佳拟合模型。左：从DES Y3源星表的不相交、随机分割子样本重建的两个独立会聚图之间的交叉功率谱 \(C_{\ell}^{\kappa_{A}\kappa_{B}}\)。由于两个子样本的形状噪声实现是统计独立的，交叉谱在无形状噪声偏差；误差棒来自10个配对的噪声实现。右：完整样本图的自动率谱 \(C_{\ell}^{\kappa\kappa}\)。实线是原始谱（信号加形状噪声），点表示减去估计的形状噪声偏差 \(N_{\ell}\) 后的谱；误差棒来自50个实现。噪声实现是通过在未掩膜像素间混洗观测到的剪切来构建的。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Tomographic AKRA 3.0 reconstruction of the DES Y3 weak-lensing data across the four source redshift bins. Left: Three-dimensional tomographic volume representation. Four effective galaxy number maps \(N_{eff}(\theta_{i})\) ( \(N_{{side}}=1024\) ) are displayed as horizontal slices within a box spanned by right ascension (RA), declination (Dec), and photometric redshift \(z\) , with the vertical axis indicating the mean redshift of each tomographic bin. The corresponding source redshift distributions \(n(z)\) are shown to the right, illustrating the radial selection of each bin. Right: Reconstructed convergence maps \(\kappa_{E}\) for each bin on the DES Y3 footprint, shown with a common color scale (red/blue: over-/under-densities of projected matter).The amplitude of \(\kappa_{E}\) increases with source redshift due to the extended lensing path and integrated lensing kernel. Maps are computed at \(N_{{side}}=1024\) ( \(A_{{pix}}\simeq 11.8\,{arcmin}^{2}\) ) up to \(\ell_{{max}}=2048\) and smoothed with a \(30^{\prime}\) Gaussian kernel for visualization.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用近红外到远红外波段的谱能量分布（SED）分析，研究了属于两个希克森致密群（HCGs）——HCG 56和HCG 92（斯蒂芬五重星系）的星系中的恒星形成活动，这两个群都显示出明显的相互作用证据。通过结合红外卫星AKARI、斯皮策空间望远镜和赫歇尔空间天文台的数据，我们考察了星系相互作用如何影响物理条件及群成员的演化。将观测到的成员星系SED与代表恒星形成星系和活动星系核（AGN）的模型SED进行比较。使用两种独立方法估算恒星形成率（SFRs）：(i) 中红外多环芳烃（PAH）谱带强度，以及(ii) 根据模型推导出的、归因于恒星形成的远红外光度。尽管两种方法总体上结果一致，但基于PAH特征的SFRs系统性偏低，这可能是由于在一些相互作用星系中PAH被破坏。当与恒星质量作图时，所有成员星系均位于SDSS场中恒星形成星系主序带之下，表明在HCG 56和HCG 92中并未观测到相互作用引发的星暴。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，结论如下：在HCG 56和HCG 92中，星系相互作用并未如预期那样引发强烈的星暴活动；PAH破坏效应可能影响了基于PAH的SFR估算准确性。

artifacts.abstract_zh:
在Petitjean（2026, arXiv:2605.12188）中，我们重新审视了邻近阻尼莱曼α吸收体（PDLA）的起源，这些吸收体追踪类星体红移3000 km/s内的冷气体，并在统一框架内解释了它们的运动学和物理性质。我们表明，大多数PDLA与活动星系核（AGN）环境和/或类星体宿主星系有关。我们还首次对类星体相关吸收体中表现出原子基态激发能级强吸收的吸收系统进行了普查和表征。其中，幽灵型和日冕型系统出现在部分覆盖类星体发射区域的致密、紧凑气体中。大多数系统与速度高达-2000 km/s的外流有关，而较小部分的内流云速度可达+1200 km/s。
在本文中，我们提供了PDLA的更新分类，包括修订后的幽灵系统目录，其数量是先前已知探测数的两倍以上。我们通过测量和讨论堆叠光谱以及单个幽灵系统中探测到的吸收线的等值宽度，研究了这些系统的性质。特别地，我们表明，尽管大多数幽灵系统是真正的DLA，但情况并非总是如此。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：更新了PDLA分类，幽灵系统数量显著增加，且其DLA性质需逐案确认。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们展示了JWST第四周期大型项目SPURS对Abell-2744场中六个明亮的红移z=5–9星系的深紫外（UV）光谱。单个星系光谱明确探测到来自富集气体的低电离和高电离态星际介质（ISM）金属吸收线，我们利用这些谱线研究ISM气体的孔隙率和运动学。我们发现吸收轮廓存在显著的多样性。低电离气体覆盖分数在0.2到0.9之间变化，表明中性ISM具有异质性和斑块性。低电离运动学也表现出很大的多样性，速度质心值从+70 km s^{-1}到显著蓝移的-140 km s^{-1}，而高电离气体主要显示蓝移吸收，表明存在多相外流。虽然所有源都在蓝移翼中显示出外流特征，但我们还发现一半样本，特别是那些具有最低恒星质量和最高恒星形成率（sSFR）的星系，其低电离速度质心接近系统速度。这与较低红移处近乎普遍存在的低电离气体整体外流形成对比。我们认为这种运动学多样性可能是由于在最低质量和最高sSFR系统中，大部分冷气体的外流速度较低，这可能是由于夹带效率不足和/或存在未分辨的流入成分。这些光谱揭示了具有复杂气体几何和运动学的富金属ISM，并突显了深JWGT光栅光谱学在揭示再电离时代ISM特性方面的潜力。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有总结：早期星系的ISM具有复杂的气体几何和运动学特征，低质量高恒星形成率星系中冷气体外流较弱，可能是夹带效率不足或存在未分辨的流入成分，JWST深紫外光谱为再电离时代ISM研究提供了强大工具。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 半人马星系团是射电模式活动星系核反馈最重要的典型之一，其中心星系NGC 4696发射出强大的喷流，这些喷流膨胀形成X射线空腔并调节冷却和恒星形成。NGC 4696位于一个壮观的多相星云中，该星云由延伸数十千秒差距的纤维丝组成，跨越六个温度量级，从高温（10^8 K）X射线发射等离子体到冷分子气体。由于其邻近性，哈勃空间望远镜的H_α成像揭示了黑洞影响范围内一个引人注目的S形电离气体旋涡——这是在星系团核心中首次识别出的此类结构。本文展示了利用NIRSpec对NGC 4696进行的首次JWST观测，以10秒差距的分辨率探测了内部618 pc × 618 pc的区域。这些数据揭示，该电离旋涡是一个旋转的多相环核盘（CND），在物理和运动学上与更大尺度的纤维丝网络相连。这提供了长期缺失的环节，连接了千秒差距尺度的冷却流与小于100秒差距尺度上的黑洞吸积。引人注目的是，观测到的形态和运动学被定制的磁流体动力学模拟所重现，其中纤维丝气体从热大气中凝聚，失去角动量，并供给一个旋转的环核盘，该环核盘介导了向黑洞的吸积。NGC 1275（英仙座星系团的中心星系）中的类似结构，连同我们关于NGC 4696的结果——两个典型的射电模式活动星系核反馈系统——指向一个共同机制：多相纤维丝通过环核盘将气体从星系团尺度输送到黑洞附近，从而闭合活动星系核反馈回路，并为自调节的星系演化建立一个基于物理的框架。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：多相纤维丝将气体从星系团尺度输送到黑洞附近的环核盘，后者介导黑洞吸积，从而闭合了AGN反馈回路。NGC 4696与NGC 1275的相似性表明这是一种普遍的射电模式AGN反馈机制。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Top panel: Composite large-scale image of the Centaurus cluster. Chandra 0.5 to 7 keV image in blue. HST/WFC3 F665N (containing redshifted H \(\alpha\) ), with the continuum estimated from F814W and subtracted, shown in red. The field of view (FoV) of JWST/NIRspec is shown with the cyan square. Middle and bottom panels: The central \(760\) pc \(\times~550\) pc of NGC 4696. Top-left: HST/WFC3 F665N (containing redshifted H \(\alpha\) ), with the continuum estimated from F814W and subtracted, revealing the S-shaped ionized swirl. The approximate edge of the assumed CND is shown in a red circle. Top-right: same image in greyscale but with Pa \(\alpha\) flux map (NIRSpec) overlaid. Bottom-left/right: same with \(v_{50}\) (centroid velocity) and \(w_{80}\) (80% line width) maps, respectively, derived from the NIRSpec cube (Section II ). We see a CND connected to a filamentary structure to the west. The AGN position (Fabian et al. , 2016 ) is marked (green circle), with the arrow in \(v_{50}\) indicating the VLBA jet direction (Taylor et al. , 2006 ) ; velocities are relative to the systemic of NGC 4696.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：上方面板：半人马星系团的复合大尺度图像。蓝色为钱德拉0.5至7 keV图像。红色为HST/WFC3 F665N（包含红移的H \(\alpha\)），其中连续谱由F814W估计并扣除。青色方框表示JWST/NIRspec的视场。中间和下方面板：NGC 4696的中心\(760\) pc \(\times~550\) pc区域。左上：HST/WFC3 F665N（包含红移的H \(\alpha\)），其中连续谱由F814W估计并扣除，揭示了S形电离旋涡。红色圆圈表示假定的CND的大致边界。右上：相同图像的灰度图，但叠加了Pa \(\alpha\) 流量图（NIRSpec）。左下/右：分别来自NIRSpec数据立方体（第二节）的\(v_{50}\)（质心速度）和\(w_{80}\)（80%线宽）图。我们看到一个CND连接到西侧的一个纤维丝结构。AGN位置（Fabian et al. , 2016 ）用绿色圆圈标记，\(v_{50}\)中的箭头指示VLBA喷流方向（Taylor et al. , 2006 ）；速度相对于NGC 4696的系统速度。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Top panels: a) Snapshot of projected large-scale 3DMHD simulated filament network. b) Snapshot of 3DMHD simulated velocity field within a NIRSpec/IFU field of view, showing only cool gas with a surface density greater than \(1\%\) of the maximum. Both snapshots shown in panels a) and b) corresponds to \(t=40\) Myr of the 3DMHD simulations. Bottom panels: c) Evolution of the outer radius of the kpc-scale filaments (blue) and the cool ( \(\sim 10^{4-5}\) K) CND (orange) as a function of time. We define the CND size as the radius at which the spherically averaged angular momentum of the cool gas drops below 95% of the Keplerian value. The filaments rapidly expand to kpc scales and remain relatively stable, while the CND exhibits variability, with episodic growth and contraction on \(\sim\) 10-100 pc scales. The disc size of the CND in NGC 4696 (this work) and NGC 1275 (Oosterloo et al. , 2024 ) are also shown. d) Same as Panel c), but tracing the evolution of the orientation of the CND as traced by its angular momentum direction along three different projections.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：上方面板：a) 投影的大尺度3DMHD模拟纤维丝网络的快照。b) NIRSpec/IFU视场内的3DMHD模拟速度场快照，仅显示表面密度大于最大值的\(1\%\)的冷气体。面板a)和b)中显示的两个快照对应于3DMHD模拟的\(t=40\) Myr。下方面板：c) kpc尺度纤维丝（蓝色）和冷（\(\sim 10^{4-5}\) K）CND（橙色）的外半径随时间的变化。我们将CND大小定义为冷气体的球平均角动量下降到开普勒值的95%以下的半径。纤维丝迅速膨胀到kpc尺度并保持相对稳定，而CND表现出变异性，在\(\sim\) 10-100 pc尺度上具有间歇性增长和收缩。还显示了NGC 4696（本文）和NGC 1275（Oosterloo et al. , 2024 ）中CND的盘大小。d) 与面板c)相同，但追踪了CND取向的演化，由其角动量方向沿三个不同投影表示。

artifacts.abstract_zh: NIRCam中波段已被证明能高效识别具有高等值宽度(EW) Hα和[OIII]+Hβ发射线的发射线星系(ELGs)。本文利用这一效率，通过CANUCS、Technicolor和JUMPS巡天的中波段成像，识别了一个红移范围在4.9 ≲ z ≲ 8.9的ELGs样本。我们发现，ELGs的连续谱颜色与发射线强度之间存在强相关性，即紫外/光学连续谱更蓝的星系具有更强的Hα和[OIII]+Hβ发射线。我们识别出26个偏离该相关性的星系，称之为红色发射线星系(REGs)，因为它们具有红色的连续谱颜色和强的发射线。我们将REGs分为三类：1) 根据常见文献标准选出的“经典”小红点(LRDs)；2) 在F444W波段中可分辨的、与尘埃恒星形成星系(DSFGs)一致的延展REGs；以及3) 在F444W波段中不可分辨但未被归类为LRDs的致密REGs。致密REGs因多种原因未能通过常见的LRD选择标准，包括连续谱微弱、发射线（非常强的[OIII]+Hβ）污染，以及紫外/光学颜色比LRDs更平坦。我们得出结论，致密REGs很可能是被“经典”选择标准遗漏的LRDs，因此现有样本中缺失了它们。我们的结果表明，中波段选择方法可以提供这些天体更完整的样本。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，致密REGs很可能是被经典LRD选择标准遗漏的对象，中波段选择方法可以提供更完整的样本。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Color-color diagrams for galaxies with the H \(\alpha\) or [OIII] + H \(\beta\) emission lines in one of the \(F410M\) (top left), \(F430M\) (top right), \(F460M\) (bottom left), and \(F480M\) (bottom right) bands, with the sample filtered to galaxies at the correct redshift (see also Table 1 ). In each panel, the \(y-\) axis color highlights the rest-frame UV-optical continuum, using \(F150W\) to measure the rest-frame UV, and either \(F360M\) or \(F410M\) to measure the rest-frame optical (see Table 1 ). The \(x\) -axis color then highlights the strength of the H \(\alpha\) or [OIII] + H \(\beta\) emission lines, using either \(F360M\) or \(F410M\) to measure the rest-frame optical continuum, and the band containing an emission line. Bluer \(x-\) axis colors indicate stronger emission lines while redder colors indicate weaker lines.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：在F410M（左上）、F430M（右上）、F460M（左下）和F480M（右下）波段之一中具有H \(\alpha\) 或[OIII] + H \(\beta\) 发射线的星系的双色图，样本已过滤至正确红移的星系（另见表1）。在每个面板中，\(y-\) 轴颜色突出显示静止系紫外-光学连续谱，使用F150W测量静止系紫外，并使用F360M或F410M测量静止系光学（见表1）。\(x\) 轴颜色则突出显示H \(\alpha\) 或[OIII] + H \(\beta\) 发射线的强度，使用F360M或F410M测量静止系光学连续谱，以及包含发射线的波段。更蓝的\(x-\) 轴颜色表示更强的发射线，而更红的颜色表示更弱的线。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: All four panels in Figure 1 combined onto one panel. There is a correlation between emission line strength and continuum color, where bluer galaxies have stronger emission lines (bottom right), and redder galaxies have weaker emission lines (top left). We fit both samples with a straight line which allows us to calculate an expected continuum color based on a given emission line color. We then define the REGs (pink stars) as galaxies with continuum colors \(\geq 2\sigma\) redder than this fit. Fitting for the line- and photo- \(z\) -selected samples were performed separately, and we show the best fit (solid black line) and \(2\sigma\) selection criteria (dashed line) for the line-selected sample only. The best fit and selection for the photo- \(z\) -selected sample is similar to the line-selected. The side panels show four examples of different kinds of SEDs found in this diagram, including a blue galaxy with very strong emission lines (bottom right), an average ELG with a flat continuum and strong emission lines (bottom left), galaxy with red continuum fluxes and weak emission lines (top left), and a REG (top right). The EWs reported for each example are measured directly from the medium-band photometry, as described in § III.4 .
figures.caption_zh: 图2：图1中的所有四个面板合并到一个面板中。发射线强度与连续谱颜色之间存在相关性，其中更蓝的星系具有更强的发射线（右下），而更红的星系具有更弱的发射线（左上）。我们用一条直线拟合两个样本，从而可以根据给定的发射线颜色计算预期的连续谱颜色。然后，我们将连续谱颜色比该拟合红\(\geq 2\sigma\) 的星系定义为REGs（粉色星形）。对线选和光选样本的拟合是分别进行的，我们仅显示线选样本的最佳拟合（实黑线）和\(2\sigma\) 选择标准（虚线）。光选样本的最佳拟合和选择标准与线选样本相似。侧面板显示了该图中发现的四种不同SED示例，包括具有非常强发射线的蓝星系（右下）、具有平坦连续谱和强发射线的平均ELG（左下）、具有红色连续谱通量和弱发射线的星系（左上）以及一个REG（右上）。每个示例报告的EW是直接从介质波段测光中测量的，如§ III.4所述。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: EW(H \(\alpha\) ) (left) and EW([OIII] + H \(\beta\) ) (right) vs. photometric redshift for our samples. REGs which ony heave measurements of the [OIII] + H \(\beta\) emission lines are outlined with a grey outline. The sample of REGs have a wide range of EWs, and include both some of the lowest and highest EW objects in the line- and photo- \(z\) -selected samples.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：EW(H \(\alpha\) )（左）和EW([OIII] + H \(\beta\) )（右）与样本的光度红移的关系。仅具有[OIII] + H \(\beta\) 发射线测量的REGs用灰色轮廓标出。REGs样本具有广泛的EW范围，并且包括线选和光选样本中一些最低和最高EW的天体。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: \(F150W-F444W\) vs. \(F444W\) magnitude diagram for our samples. We also show the \(F150W-F444W\) ERO color cuts from Williams et al. 2024 (solid line), Gottumukkala et al. 2024 (dahsed line), and Barrufet et al. 2025b (dash-dot line). Roughly half the REGs qualify as EROs based on at least one of these criteria, and the REG LRDs have similar colors and magnitudes to the full sample of LRDs in CANUCS.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：样本的\(F150W-F444W\) 与\(F444W\) 星等图。我们还显示了来自Williams等人2024（实线）、Gottumukkala等人2024（虚线）和Barrufet等人2025b（点划线）的\(F150W-F444W\) ERO颜色切割。大约一半的REGs基于这些标准中的至少一个符合ERO条件，并且REG LRDs的颜色和星等与CANUCS中LRDs的完整样本相似。
